title: 0th correctional officer
description: Ji-hun, a former member of a secret special forces unit under the Special Operations Planning Office of the South Korean Army Headquarters, returns from a long overseas deployment-- only to receive the news that his younger sister Ji-yun has died, and that the person accused of killing her is none other than her boyfriend, Seo Min-jun. While still struggling to accept the fact that his sister is gone, Ji-hun, who trusted Min-jun, learns that Min-jun was falsely accused and had gone to Yeokseon Prison in search of Ji-yun's real killer. But eventually, Min-jun also meets his death inside the prison. Determined to uncover the truth behind the unjust deaths of both Ji-yun and Min-jun, Ji-hun becomes a prison guard and heads to Yeokseon Prison to uncover the secrets hidden within.

title: 100 Million Years Later: The Ultimate Weapon's Return
description: After humanity continuously polluted the world with waste, a monstrous being known as a "Corrupter" was born. As these creatures spread and eroded the world, humanity was pushed to the brink of extinction. The strongest agent, Jin Shido, finally obtained the power to save the world through dangerous human experimentation. However, it was already too late--99% of humanity had already perished. Entrusting hope to the future, Jin entered a long slumber. --And then, 100 million years later. On a newly reborn Earth, Jin awakens and smiles. "...I knew it. It was right to believe in the possibilities of the future."

title: 18 Year Old Demon King
description: Rabis Vindica, the son of the Great Demon King who rules the Demon Realm. After acting on his own and wiping out a rebellious demon noble family, he is punished with banishment to the Human World. Living in the body of an ordinary student, Rabis soon discovers that the demonic power he should no longer be able to use still reacts to evil. As he gradually relearns how to wield his power, he begins searching for a way to return to the Demon Realm.

title: A Better Labor
description: After the great explosion, the world could never return to what it once was. Divided into small countries driven by specialized labor forces, it's now a dog-eat-dog new world. But Clawhammer Jang listens to more than just his stomach. As he pushes forward, he joins forces with others, new friends also gifted with immense power following the aftermath of the great explosion. But is Jang strong enough to stand for what he believes in? And who will stand with him?

title: A Cadet Becomes a Prophet?!
description: Money maniac Fernan Pellenberg is the young heir of House Pellenberg, one of the Empire's most prestigious houses, and a top student at the Imperial Academy. However, he's infamous for something else: his obsession with money. As a ruthless money-hound, he only acknowledges those who bring him profit and views everything in the world through the lens of monetary value. People avoid him, finding his greed repulsive. But was divine punishment finally upon him? One day, out of nowhere, disaster strikes Fernan like a bolt from the blue. As his consciousness begins to fade, something attempts to invade and take over his mind, but Fernan forcefully expels it instead. From that moment on, he begins to see something strange: a prophetic book that reveals the future. And not just any future, but a prophecy of the end of the world.

title: A Revenge Guide for the Terminally Ill Maid
description: Framed for a crime she didn't commit, Isabel died leaving behind her little daughter. 10 years later, she awakens in another woman's body, with only one year left to live. But the world she returns to is even crueler. Her daughter is now married to the very man who murdered her, all in the name of revenge. With just one year, Isabel must find a way to save her daughter, no matter the cost.

title: A Wimp's Strategy Guide to Conquer the Tower
description: One day, mysterious black towers suddenly rose all over the world, and a chosen few began to awaken. But for Bong Joohyuk--a wimpy, down-on-his-luck nobody--it was something that should have had nothing to do with him. After another exhausting day at his part-time job, he was just about to take a bite of ramen when-- [Bong Joohyuk, you have awakened.] "...Eh, fuck, what the hell?!" Is this finally his chance to turn his life around?

title: Absolute Ultimate Martial Lord
description: Born with blocked meridians, the boy Sowoon was slow to speak and grow. After meeting the esteemed figures of the Wudang Sect, he was cherished like a precious gem and grew up under their care. He eventually formed ties with the Six Martial Lords of the Orthodox Faction—monstrous prodigies whose martial prowess defied common sense. Just then, the Demon Cult emerged in the martial world, leading to a grand battle that would shake the land...! The exhilarating and thrilling golden era of Sowoon and the Six Divine Lords in the Jianghu!

title: After being laid off, I got hundreds of millions of systems, and I upgraded them alone
description: The company was acquired, and the game otaku who was "optimized" was proposed to break up by his girlfriend? Is it a collapse or a broken can? Ye Fei shook his head: No, I don't want it! The best AI beauties bring hundreds of millions of systems, the more you spend,

title: After Rebirth, I Used Mirror Reversal For Vengeance
description: 50 years after the game world merging with reality, a top warrior appeared. He devoted his Whole life to the world, yet was ultimately killed by the king out of fear and jealousy. Before his death, he awakened the mirror ability and sealed his soul beneath the lake's surface. The king covered up the true history and fabricated a new one, branding the warrior as a traitor in the eyes of the world. Decades later, the warrior awakened in the body of a dying man and began his vengeance using mirror ability.

title: After Reincarnation, My Enemy Made Me Invincible with Money
description: In the apocalyptic era, my sisters and I struggled to survive, but in the eyes of the rich and powerful, we were nothing more than ants. Just before I died, I awakened a special ability to be reincarnated. I was reborn directly into the family of my greatest enemy. Now, I will make them pour all of their resources into raising me, only so I can become their ultimate destruction!

title: After the Moonlight Falls
description: Stripped of everything by vampires, Han Segun's fate changes forever when he crosses paths with Sylvester, a legendary demon hunter. From the ashes of his past, he steps onto a new path of vengeance... Welcome to the World of the Mad Moon.

title: After the School Belle Dumped Me, I Became a Martial Arts God
description: Fang Yi transmigrated into a new world, only to be dumped by his school belle girlfriend right after arriving. He thought it was just the beginning of a cliché urban romance story... Until the system warned him: "Spiritual energy will awaken in one year. The world will face great upheaval. The apocalypse is coming." "With a system by my side, why should I be afraid of anything?"

title: Almighty Pig Slaughtering Knife
description: Ye Chuan -- a mental patient -- sees all living creatures as pigs. On the day of his job assignment, he awakened a life-class profession: Butcher. His teachers and classmates were bitterly disappointed, and even his childhood sweetheart left him. However, this seemingly useless profession granted him two unique traits: o He deals extra damage to pigs. o Damage from pigs is halved. And since everyone looks like pigs in his eyes, armed with just a butcher's knife, Ye Chuan begins his incredible rise to godhood.

title: An Appraiser Taken In by a Meritocracy — After Abandoning the Homeland That Treated Me Like a Slave, I Started as the Enemy Nation's Hero.
description: "You have real ability. Your circumstances just held you back." Alto is a young appraiser forced to work like a slave in the nobility-ruled Kingdom of Dramd. His life changes completely when he's scouted by Beralt, a soldier of the enemy nation, the Glaus Empire. In a country that runs purely on merit, Alto's off-the-charts appraisal talent is recognized--and he's suddenly made an officer-candidate!? No sooner has he enlisted than the high command--stacked with powerhouses--pins great hopes on him, but the companions he takes in are all misfits written off as hopeless... A breezy, rise-to-the-top fantasy about seeing the hidden talents of his comrades and carving out a new destiny!

title: Ankle Breaker
description: NA

title: Anti-hero at the bottom of the job caste system
description: In a world where the value of existence is determined by occupation (class), the protagonist awakens to the skills of a "thief" and is persecuted as a "harmful designated class". One day, he is saved by Aoi, the head of Shinobi Street, a town where people who are also persecuted gather, and decides to become his friend. However, the peace is fleeting, and the city of Shinobi is attacked by a mysterious group, and his friends are killed one after another. At that time, Hitoshi's skill, which he could only watch, awakens and acquires the "skill to steal the skill of the dead". Hitoshi uses this skill and vows to take revenge on the mastermind who killed his friends.

title: Artemis
description: Artemis, a special agent and transcendent being, is on a mission to protect humanity from threats posed by other transcendent beings like herself. The story unfolds as she begins to question her group and her identity.

title: Assistant
description: Ju Won, an 8-year veteran freelance killer (assistant). He gets caught up in big trouble when he meets a new assistant,

title: Awakening the Purple Thunder at the Beginning
description: In the world of Blue Star, fierce beasts are rampant. Everyone can awaken superpowers and have the opportunity to become a strong man and dominate the world! However, Xu Jingming, who traveled through time, only had E-level superpowers. Fortunately, the Deep Blue System appeared, and the E-level weak electric superpower was upgraded to S-level Purple Thunder! Killing fierce beasts will earn you superpower points! Superpower points -1500000, Purple Thunder will evolve! SSS-level Chaos Thunder! Thus, the legend of Xu Jingming was left on Blue Star.

title: Back from the Abyss: I Am the Disaster
description: The Immortal Emperor family was wiped out overnight, and the young master Li Chen was thrown into the most mysterious and dangerous abyss! Eight years later, he broke out of the abyss, the empress in his left hand, and the gods and demons in his right hand, and everything he went was

title: Bad Business
description: Jay, a legendary hitman in the American underworld, is hired by Union—North America’s largest killer company—to destroy the killer company established by his friend Johnny with his own hands. The condition for accepting the contract was that Johnny’s life would be spared, but both Johnny and Jay are killed due to Union’s betrayal. However, through mysterious power, Jay is resurrected in the body of an ordinary Korean young man and meets Johnny, who has been resurrected in the body of a young woman. The two decide to join forces again and establish a powerful “company” to take revenge on Union, which killed them.

title: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World
description: he man prayed every night to every god in existence. He begged that, upon waking the next day, he would find himself in the middle of a wondrous fantasy. One day, his prayer was finally answered. Yet it took a shape that was nothing like what he had wished for.

title: Became the Rebel of the Necromancer Family
description: NA

title: Breakers
description: Joo In-gong was dragged into the remake of a game he was playing called . However, something wasn't right. The only playable characters should be Loch of the human side and Zephyr of the demon side. Instead, he awakens in the body of Shutra, the ninth prince of the Demon Realm, a character who actually didn't exist in the game’s story. Granted two mysterious powers, "Protagonist Setting Adjustment" and "Power of Conquest," Joo In-gong now must alter the game's plot to survive against Zephyr. Yet, with every twist of the plot, he garners more attention

title: Cerberus
description: Living with his mother Yukie (53) in Shin-Okubo, Tokyo, Kai Fukutome (21) is walking his childhood friend Rika (21) home after celebrating Yukie's birthday when they are suddenly attacked by a stranger. Somehow, Kai and Rika manage to escape, but... A few days later, Kai's best friend Park Yujun (21), a Korean resident in Japan, is murdered by the very same man. The tragedy doesn't end there--Yukie and Rika are also caught up in the incident, leaving Rika in a coma and Yukie dead. In the aftermath, shocking truths come to light: Yujun had secretly been a spy for "Nation N," Kai has an estranged twin brother--Im Jin, a superstar member of the mega-popular K-pop boy group Littlegang--and his father, Im Dohyun (53), who abandoned him long ago, is living in Korea. Overnight, Kai's fate is thrown into motion. To avenge his mother and best friend, and to uncover his own roots, he sets off alone for Seoul. But what awaits him there...!?

title: Chronicle of Runes
description: In a world where Runecraft thrives, Van is born with the Asura Rune, the most accursed rune in history, said to bring only ruin. When a sorcerer coveting its power strikes, Van loses everything and is sealed inside a pocket dimension, severed from the mortal realm. Drowning in despair yet fueled by unquenchable rage, he refuses to die. For 999 years, he hones his blade of vengeance. At last, he unlocks the Asura Rune's true power, tears open his prison, and returns to the world, bringing destruction with him.

title: Chronicles of the Lazy Sovereign
description: The great martial artist who ended the chaos of the world. The Shining Supreme Martial Artist, Wi Yeonho. He was a true gentleman, a great man, and a noble hero... "That guy? He was a total piece of trash." A truth too shameful to be revealed to the world. The true nature of the so-called greatest hero of all time is finally exposed!

title: City of Sins
description: Born of demon and elf blood, a boy burdened with crushing expectations steps boldly onto a battlefield of ruin and renewal. Driven by an unbreakable obsession, he forges through rivers of molten lava, shatters realms of eternal ice, and battles across barren wastelands, all for a single purpose: to surpass the towering figure far ahead. One day, when he finally drives his blade into the earth and surveys the silence around him, he finds no enemies left standing. Only then does he realize that the insurmountable peak he once chased now lies beneath his feet.

title: Colorist
description: A world stained black. Due to creatures, humanity is driven into a giant city where light and color converge. Humanity continues its pioneering efforts to reclaim the world, and Kay, a boy who wishes to become a member of the pioneering corps. However, he is ostracized for being "colorless" (????)--someone without color. Then one day, due to an unfortunate incident, Kay gains the color black...

title: Corrupt City
description: After years of toil and ridicule, one man finally found the Artifacts--remnants of a lost technology so advanced that they cannot be replicated. Several years later, that same man founded a criminal organization in Korea--the Daejung Syndicate. The man expanded his influence using five child soldiers he armed with Artifacts, and Gilja is one of them. But Gilja soon realizes that the Artifacts can free her of the syndicate entirely. However, this freedom comes with a steep price...

title: Criminal Transfer Student
description: Akihito committed a grave crime. Presumed sentence: 500 years in prison. To him, the government proposed a system called the Criminal Transfer Program. Under this program, a prisoner transfers to a troubled high school, and for each problem they resolve within the school, their sentence is reduced. Now, as a criminal transfer student, Akihito must face gangs, conspiracies, and the shadows of his own past.

title: Curse of the Vengeful Tongue
description: Gin Asuhara is a promising young detective with unparalleled physical abilities. However, following a certain incident, he finds himself forced into a Master-Servant Contract with his senior detective, Hidemi Mera.

title: Daesahyeong Lee-Hoe
description: Lee Hoo was never a hero. Talentless and overlooked, the Eldest Martial Brother of the Seongui Sect spent his life cooking, cleaning, and sacrificing himself for others--only to die helplessly at the hands of the Blood Cult. But when he opens his eyes in the past, he vows to live differently this time. No more regrets. No more sacrifices. And definitely no more playing the fool for everyone else. Yet somehow, the life he wanted slips completely out of control. The martial arts that once rejected him now bend effortlessly to his will. Legendary masters call him a genius beyond heaven, and Murim begins to revolve around the man who was once considered worthless. The story of a second chance begins.

title: Dan, the Bat-Wielding Knight
description: Top of the 9th, two outs. The 'Bat Knight' aims for a comeback as his home run begins! An unknown power dwells within his baseball bat. Dan's adventure to smash the monsters of another world and find his way home!

title: Daoist Master Wants to Ascend
description: The story of Li Yuan, a man who dreams of ascending to the heavens and resolutely sets foot on the path of cultivation. With unwavering devotion, he prays to the heavens to grant him divine ordination, vowing to break free from the shackles of the mortal world and pursue eternal life.

title: Dead End Demonics: The First Returner
description: Eight years ago, an unknown catastrophe called ("Demonization") struck the world. It is a calamity that seals off parts of reality and overwrites them with a nightmare realm--if you cannot survive, only a cruel death awaits. In this changed world, Yugo Fushimi lives a quiet, withdrawn life, limiting his outings to commuting between home and work. Gentle, timid, and overly sensitive to others' pain, he is always sleep-deprived and often late, leading his coworkers to mock him as a "clumsy do-gooder" and a "shut-in introvert." One day, he is forcibly dragged out to a drinking party--and there, he witnesses the horror of Demonization firsthand. The city is trampled, people scream and cry, his coworkers collapse one after another, and grotesque enemies flood the area as it transforms into a demon realm where survival seems impossible. At that moment, in the midst of despair, Yugo alone grips his weapon as if remembering something long forgotten--hinting that he may be a "returner," someone with a hidden past connection to this nightmare and the power to fight back.

title: Debtbound by Blood
description: Kim Sang-an is a cold-blooded loan shark. When his younger sister, a schoolteacher, takes her own life after relentless bullying from her students, he becomes the homeroom teacher of those very students to collect the price of her life. A merciless loan shark who will collect his debts even if it means descending into hell and a class of devil-like students... A vicious, twisted teacher-student relationship.

title: Defense Breaker
description: Jihoon is pulled into a defense game. He's forced to become the captain of the knights and defend the kingdom from monsters. But the wounds he received from people haven't healed yet, so he refuses to protect the kingdom. Then suddenly, a new route opens up...

title: Demon Rakshasa
description: Hong Do-jin, a gangster. Borrowing the power of a monster, he takes revenge.

title: Demonic Beast Hunter Survival Guide
description: For 12 years, Woojin suffered from mysterious nightmares of unknown origin, until he suddenly met his death... When he opened his eyes, he found himself not in the real world, but inside the very world from his nightmares--the "Demon Realm." Using the skills he had honed all this time, Woojin hunts demon beasts and grows stronger with each kill. As a beast hunter, he begins living a brand-new life. 'A dark fantasy world where you grow stronger the more you hunt? Honestly, that's better.'

title: Demonic Frontline: The Thirteenth Flying Dragon
description: Once the shame of his family, now an overpowered martial arts prodigy with a perfect memory?! "I died and returned to the front lines, and this time, I'm no longer the pig I used to be!

title: Devil and Ice
description: The strongest from another world are reborn--so much for a normal life. The Heavenly Demon, who was on the brink of conquering the world. After dying together in a final showdown with his archenemy, the Ice Witch, the two are reborn as ordinary twins in the human world. But their peace is short-lived. Now that they are teenagers, organizations of Reincarnators are shaking up the world. The world refuses to leave these siblings alone, even as they try to hide the powers of their past lives. Old subordinates begin to gather, one by one. And the Ice Witch stands by his side--not as an enemy this time, but as a partner. Will the Heavenly Demon be able to become the world's strongest once again?!

title: Devil Summoner, I am the Abyss Lord
description: Lin Tianhao, who has transmigrated to another world, attends the Job Change Ceremony and ends up taking on a "sewer-tier" job -- Summoner. Just as everyone is mocking him, believing his future is doomed, he suddenly awakens a system and gains the skill [Demonic Sacrifice]! Who says the Summoner class is trash? I have the strongest SSS-rank talent

title: Doctor Brothers
description: If only my brother hadn't existed -- my life would have been a little better..." Kyoji Kato is busy with part-time work and lives a gloomy life. He has an unshakable inferiority complex towards his older brother Kyoichiro, who took over from their late father and is active overseas as a genius doctor. One night, he gets a phone call from his mother. "My brother...Kyoichiro has died." Kyoji, who was in a daze after suddenly losing someone important to him, was cleaning up his brother's room when he suddenly had a seizure and lost consciousness. He wakes up to find out 11 years ago. In the midst of the confusion, his brother appears in front of him in his younger days, confronting the hospital director, Otomo. "You killed my father!!" With those words, he has another seizure and is pulled back to the present. -- Carrying the memories of his brother. The shadow of Otomo appears behind the deaths of his father and brother. In order to uncover the truth, Kyoji aspires to become a doctor. The gears of memory and revenge begin to turn. The past and present intertwine, and a tale of memory inheritance and revenge begins now!

title: Don't Look for the Resurrected Villainess
description: NA

title: Don't Tell Me You Think Cultivating Immortality Is Difficult?
description: A humble rookie seeks the path to immortality -- only to accidentally join a sect full of pretentious con artists. His seven senior brothers brim with confidence, taking turns spouting out fabricated divine techniques. But no one expected this newcomer to be a genius. He actually comprehends everything -- even their nonsense! In the end, the master falls into despair. Just who is this junior disciple?

title: Doomsday Arrival: Evolution into the Crimson King
description: As the apocalyptic red fog engulfs the city, Yan Hao witnesses the tragic deaths of his loved ones and the disappearance of his sister. Driven by revenge and a search for his family, he joins humanity's last line of defense, yet harbors a most dangerous secret: a power surging within him, shared with the power of otherworldly beasts! In a post-apocalyptic battlefield rife with blood and flesh, he walks the fine line between hero and monster, devouring otherworldly beasts for strength, yet constantly on the verge of losing control! Continuously evolving, he absorbs the beasts' abilities and takes them for himself! Slaughtering all before revealing his true form, he becomes the Crimson King!

title: Doomsday Game: Rise of the Villain
description: I am a hardcore player who is as good as a god in the popular apocalypse game "Biochemical Wasteland". In order to earn money to treat my father's illness, I accepted a mysterious mission invitation in the game! I thought that what was waiting for me was a daily routine of eating, sleeping and fighting monsters, but I didn't expect that I would become the weakest villain zombie in the game! But I gradually grasped the survival rules of the apocalypse and started the road to becoming the strongest zombie...

title: Doomsday Smuggler: I Trade Spicy Strips for Gold Bars
description: In the apocalypse, the smuggler reigns, and spicy strips are king! While other people's online snack orders go wrong, Chen Yang receives a "bonus" ring that lets him travel to a wasteland world. In the real world he's a boss; in the ruined world he becomes an overlord. As others are still struggling just to survive, he's already using spicy strips to trade for technology and climbing straight to the peak of life.

title: Dungeon Architect
description: Kang Chiwoo lost his life in an accident and got reincarnated as the son of a great demon lord in another world. Unlike his previous life as a map designer, he is now a loser named Kella. However, in a world where magic exists and having realized the dormant power of Kella, Chiwoo sets out to achieve his goal of creating his dream map that he couldn't make in his past life... Will Kella be able to create his own map while fending off his brothers who constantly try to kill him, the countless threats upon his life, and the pressure of those around him who want him to succeed the throne?

title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
description: You know what's worse than breaking up with your girlfriend? Getting stuck on a sadistic alien gameshow with her cat. Join Carl and Princess Donut as they try to survive the end of the world -- or just get to the next level of a trap-filled fantasy dungeon.

title: Dungeon Games: The Ex-Corporate Slave Dominates with the Ultimate Job,
description: Yuma Anno, a corporate slave who has given up on life, suddenly awakens to the legendary profession of "Playboy" in a world invaded by dungeons. His skills are truly outlandish. With skills such as "Bluffing," which distorts the perception of others, and "Playfulness," which brings out the hidden potential of items, and his free-spirited thinking, he conquers the dungeons. Yuma, who has rediscovered his joy, gives courage to the people he meets in the dungeons. "Playing expands people's potential." A heartwarming tale of unparalleled power for modern people burdened with worries begins here!

title: Dungeon porter
description: A world where only those with innate talent can become adventurers who conquer dungeons.The world defined "Nagi" as a porter who cannot become an adventurer.But if you clear a dungeon, doesn't that make you an adventurer?Combat skills: 0! Survival abilities: Max level!The dungeon conquest story of the all-purpose porter, Nagi, defying fate!

title: Echoes of the Reverse Planet
description: After being transferred into the dimension of [Reverse Planet], the world's most popular online VR game, the ordinary college student Baek Woohyun returns. It was the homecoming he had dreamed of... except the damn game is still running as if nothing ever happened, and the vengeful shades of comrades who died over there hound him day and night, urging him to take revenge. Determined to uncover the connection between the game and the world he escaped from, Woohyun logs back into [Reverse Planet]. For better or for worse, he doesn't cross over again, but he does appear on a streamer's broadcast during a chance encounter... Then an anonymous watcher named "Viewer 62" sends him a message. "How does it feel to be back in reality?" ??? ????, Superhuman's Gaming Stream

title: Emperor of Solo Play
description: Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life--only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he's determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? The Emperor of Solo Play is back, and this time, he's playing by his own rules.

title: Empire of the Ants
description: Human Civilization: Jonathan Wells inherits his uncle's house and moves in with his family. Wanting to learn more about his uncle, Jonathan receives a note from his grandmother containing Edmond Wells' final warning: never go down into the basement. By chance, Jonathan enters the basement once, and afterward finds himself drawn back to it as if under a spell, pulled deeper into mysteries his uncle left behind.

title: Even Today, the Ranker Dreams of Retirement
description: A sister rewinds time to rescue her brother from doom, but fate laughs: he's now the reluctant vessel of a godlike Constellation begging him to "destroy the world" while he shrugs ("But I just got rich and found my family?"). As S-rank hunters swarm him for his power, she fights to preserve his carefree NEET dreams in this chaotic comedy of cosmic proportions.

title: Extraordinary World! I, a vampire...
description: Ten years ago, when faced with an alien civilization's invasion, Earth's "Extraordinary" ability users not only stood up to fight back, but also transferred their powers into "ability books" for ordinary people to learn. After humanity joined forces to repel the alien invaders, Earth had already become a world where only "ability users" reign supreme. Today, Quinn--whose parents died in battle and who has no money to buy an "ability book"--steps through the gates of the military academy. What no one knows is that he is desperately craving blood...

title: Fantasy Enlistment Squad
description: The Jeokun Mountains, the immediate border between the Demon Tribe and the Alien Federation, are the final strategic stronghold where training and actual combat occur simultaneously. The Federation forces are constantly recruiting and selecting soldiers to find the ten Transcendents revealed in the Book of Prophecy and reclaim lost territory. However, more terrifying than the war with the Demon Tribe are the absurdities and harsh treatment of military life.

title: Feasting Lord in Another world
description: A revolution is born in the humble fishing village of Evergreen... and it's about to shake an entire world! Reincarnated in a new realm, a brilliant nutritionist rises--not with swords or sorcery, but with knowledge, flavor, and unstoppable ambition. Armed with modern culinary science, they're ready to turn simple ingredients into a delicious empire. From a modest kitchen sparks a conquest unlike any other-- A conquest of kingdoms through taste. A takeover powered by innovation, strategy, and mouth-watering creations this world has never imagined. Prepare for a feast of ambition, transformation, and flavor that changes destiny itself. Welcome to Evergreen

title: Fight Monsters with Monsters
description: Kim Han-ul dreamed of becoming the world's greatest Hunter. But blocked by the insurmountable wall of talent, he's stuck as a lowly E-Rank Hunter, barely making ends meet as a gaming streamer. One day, his go-to tower defense game announces its sudden end of service. As a final send-off, Han-ul challenges the legendary 700th wave... a notoriously impossible stage no player has ever beaten and miraculously clears it. In that exact moment, a blinding light consumes him, and he undergoes a Second Awakening! He finally has his hands on a top-tier skill. This is his chance to rise the ranks and make his Hunter dreams a reality! But wait... something feels off. As he tries to test out his newfound power, the monsters he summons are completely different from the badass creatures he expected...?!

title: Fighting App: Level Up or Get Beat Down
description: Naoki Mizushima, a first-year high school student, spends his days being bullied and used as a practice dummy for pro-wrestling moves by his classmate, Tsukamoto. Just when he feels completely powerless, something strange appears before him -- a mysterious smartphone app called "The Fight App"? According to its suspicious description, landing a hit on someone earns you points, which can then be used to learn new combat techniques useful in battle... Desperate and with nothing to lose, Mizushima installs the app and gives it a try... But to his shock... it actually works?! Can Mizushima use The Fight App to finally protect himself...?

title: Fighting Uncle
description: Fuyuo Shigaraki, a penniless, divorced, down-and-out middle-aged man, needs to earn a massive 3 million yen for the sake of his daughter. That's when he encounters a self-proclaimed "high school girl fighter." "Hey mister, why don't you make money through fighting?" Caught up in her sweet talk, he stumbles into the underground world of brawling... But this man hides a past no one knows-- He's a former MMA fighter, the only one in the world who ever tied with the current world champion. And thus, a new "battle-crazed" warrior awakens--

title: Flash of the Exorcising Blade: The Strongest Swordsman Pierces the Darkness
description: Thirty years ago, fallen gods and fallen towers suddenly appeared across the land. Monsters poured forth from the fallen towers, destroying the world's peace. In response, all the gods above bestowed sacred weapons upon outstanding humans. Heroes who rose to reclaim peace by conquering the towers and purifying the fallen gods. Among them stood an unmatched warrior named Shotaro Kusunoki, wielder of the 'Exorcising Blade,' was hailed as one the Three Great Heroes. Watching his brother's legendary feats from the sidelines was Hiromu Kusunoki, a lowly baggage carrier who longed to see the day peace returned. However, fate took a cruel turn when the fallen god Futsunushi possesses Shotaro's body, turning him into a vessel of darkness. On the brink of death, Hiromu hears a mysterious voice call out from the Exorcising Blade. That voice is Gayamaru, the mighty god sealed within the blade. To save his brother, the boy forms a pact with the mighty god, and together, they will climb to the peak of power and overcome darkness itself! The curtains rise on a modern battle fantasy of gods, blades, and the bonds between brothers!

title: Freaky Killer
description: With a 100% mission success rate, the world's most perfect killer, Jin! But he has one fatal weakness, That is... a face so ugly it could go down in history!!!

title: Friend Counter
description: Then comes the shocking announcement: "In 24 hours, the student with the lowest number... will die." Thus begins the brutal "Friendship Severance Project," a secret death game run directly by the government. Lies, betrayal, submission--and fragile bonds of friendship. This is a lesson where your social ties determine your survival. Are friendships just shackles to be cut loose, or the only hope left to cling to? As the blood spills and true natures are revealed, can Hayato survive this nightmare?

title: From Rural Instructor to Sword Saint (Webtoon)
description: "I've recommended Master Beryl as a special instructor for the royal knights." Beryl Gardennant, a man who quietly runs a small swordsmanship dojo in a remote village, suddenly finds his peaceful life upended when one of his former students--now the young commander of the kingdom's knights, Aliucia--visits him. She urges him to come to the royal capital as a special instructor for the knights. What fate awaits Beryl as he reunites with his successful disciples and is thrust into the spotlight?

title: Frozen Warrior
description: Cheok Ryugeom, the greatest swordsman of Goryeo, plunged off a cliff with his enemy, sacrificing himself for his master. Frozen in ice for 900 years, he awakens in the modern era--his vengeance only just beginning.

title: Full-Time Awakening
description: As the captain of the Divine Legion and the strongest Awakener, Bai Yi is betrayed by a comrade, witnessing all his teammates die before his eyes. Only then does he realize he has always been a pawn of those in power. Having lost everything, he is reborn 20 years ago, back to his middle school days before awakening. At that time, his family and teammates are still alive. To save them, to avenge the betrayer, and to overthrow the entire corrupt ruling system, he embarks on a lonely path of strength.

title: Gendai Dungeon Life no Tsuzuki wa Isekai Open World de!
description: Gendai Dungeon Life no Tsuzuki wa Isekai Open World de!

title: Genius Blacksmith's Game
description: The last blacksmith and master artisan left in the world. His hands are crippled in a forge fire, rendering him unable to craft any longer. But then, a virtual reality game, Ares, comes knocking on Hyun-soo’s door.

title: Giyeon Doksik
description: Do Tong-dal, a sixty-year-old man, is on the verge of death. After dedicating forty-two years of his life to the criminal underworld, all he has left to show for it are fifteen coins. Having accomplished nothing, he prepares to meet his end, taking his last breath while being buried by snow on a mountain path... But he regresses in time, and a new life as an eighteen-year-old welcomes him. 'This life will be different.' Determined to leave his pathetic past self behind, Do Tong-dal decides to use the knowledge of the life he already lived! He plans to monopolize every fortunate opportunity and forge a new path for himself. "From the highest peak of the night, with the greatest power! Let's live a long and prosperous life!"

title: Global Horror: I Activated a Cheat Custom Mall
description: Terrifying domains descended upon every corner of the globe. Horror and dread became part of daily life. 'Mystic Exorcists' became humanity's final hope. But to truly eradicate the supernatural horrors, one must conquer the core worlds behind them. Countless exorcists charged ahead, only for nine out of ten to perish--humanity teetered on the edge of extinction. Chu Sheng, however, activated a cheat-like custom shop. Each time he entered a terrifying domain, he could choose a unique power-up. While other exorcists struggled to survive with their lives hanging by a thread, one horrifying creature after another knelt at his feet.

title: God of Killers
description: Gungnir is the strongest assassin, known throughout the underworld. He decides to retire for the sake of his girlfriend, to whom he has pledged his future, but on the night he completes his final job, his partner betrays him and he and his girlfriend are shot to death. He somehow manages to survive, but when he wakes up, he finds himself as a strange high school student! He must uncover the truth and find happiness in his second life. This is the start of a battle action drama starring the former strongest assassin.

title: Godzilla Galaxy Odyssey
description: Japan's greatest disaster, the King of the Monsters Godzilla, attacks Young Champion! The battle between mankind, Godzilla, and a new space Kaiju begins! What will become of Earth?

title: Got Dropped into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work
description: NA

title: Grand Finale
description: As climate catastrophe renders Earth uninhabitable, humanity sets its hopes on a new world: Arcadia. After years of deep-space slumber aboard the Atalante, crew member Dong Youngsoo finally awakens to a long-awaited paradise. But Arcadia is no Eden. The planet is under siege by alien invaders, and a native civilization fights desperately for survival. Caught between worlds, Youngsoo is thrust into a harrowing adventure that could reshape the fate of an entire species--and redefine what it means to call a place home.

title: Gray Ash: A New Life in the Dungeon City
description: Ash is a young man who had it all: as a captain in the Imperial Knights and fiancé to a noble lady, he was living a life anyone would envy. One day, however, his fiancée breaks off their engagement and he is summarily dismissed from the knights. Disgusted with everything, Ash leaves the empire and heads for a new land: the Rosebel Kingdom. There, in a nation that has grown more prosperous than the empire thanks to the power of dungeons, he restarts his life as a hunter and quickly makes a name for himself with his overwhelming skill. Meanwhile, back in the empire, his devoted junior Ulka sets off for Rosebel, determined to follow him. Thus begins the story of overturning a "gray," ruined life and repainting it from scratch in the dungeon city.

title: Great Sage of 100 Magic Stones
description: Tori, a boy who can only use everyday magic, works as a servant at the adventurer's guild to support his sick brother. He can only defeat slimes and obtain a small amount of magic stones. He earns a living day by day while enduring the unfair treatment he receives from the guild members. One day, he encounters a "talking book" in a cave. "Do you want to obtain a 'real magic stone'?" Those words will greatly change Tori's fate. The story of the everyday magician's "unrivaled magic stone" begins here!

title: Half Blood
description: "The most original union in history--human and ogre blood fused!" Leon, a half-blood born of human and ogre, But returning to the world as a half-breed only meant being used and betrayed by humans. Leon grew to despise them and swore revenge. Powerless and always the victim, Leon's miracle finally arrived-- a chance to take vengeance on humankind.

title: Heavenly Demon Sovereign
description: NA

title: Heavenly Martial God
description: "Who's this male prostitute-looking kid?" I am the Matchless Ha Hoo Young, the greatest martial artist reigning over all the lands! There is no one that is my equal! I was drowning in futility and emptiness because there was no more that I could accomplish in the human realm. To reach the peak of martial arts, I must become a saint! "I finally succeeded!!!" "Stop! Your ascension is not permitted!" The other saints refused my ascension due to my karma after much slaughter, and I fell, just like that. When I woke up, I was 60 years in the future. I was reborn as the second lord of the Namgoong family, Namgoong Hyuk. Where has all the internal energy that I've accumulated gone?! Moreover, I have the Nine yin energy blockage?

title: Hero Covered: Saving the World With Dark Hereditary Skills
description: One day, a crack suddenly appeared in the sky. Magatama (evil spirits) spilled out from it, transformed into demonic corpses using living creatures as vessels, and began attacking the human world. Orbs appeared to counter these, and those who obtained them became Slayers, tasked with protecting this world. Arata, an 11-year-old boy, obtained the jet-black Orb of Soot, which is not one of the five Slayer attributes. An outcast who cannot be assigned to any attribute, Arata honed his power to control soot, which eventually became a weapon that would shake the world.

title: Honestly, This 13th Regression Is Getting Tough
description: "I'm not going to save the world anymore. I don't believe in my friends either. If you are an enemy, you will kill anyone. Even if it's on your side." 13th time. He saved the world six times, but none of the endings were "right." The hero turned into a monster in an endless return. Believers are traitors, and the enemy is so far removed and thrown away. He abandoned himself to survive. Are all the regressions the same? This guy is different.

title: How to Live as a Civil Servant in Murim
description: One day, Yeon Woohyuk falls into the world of Murim and becomes a government official within it. He was once a veteran player of the martial arts detective game "The Great Detective of Daehwan Empire." Then suddenly, without warning, he finds himself reincarnated as a pokoe (detective officer) inside the game. Fortunately, he realizes that the cases from the game unfold exactly as he remembered, so he begins to adapt by solving them. But the joy is short-lived--he discovers that his ability known as "Spirit Eye" is actually the result of his dantian (energy core) being forcibly opened, putting him at risk of an early death. Being a detective is hard enough-- and now he has to learn martial arts and become a powerful master too?!

title: How to Live As the Vampire Lord
description: Vampire Eugene -- a sacrificial lamb slaughtered after half a year of running to fulfil the desires of a templar for fame. He was given a second chance at life after concluding his life with regrets. "I will never again die the same way. If I really did return to the past, no matter what it takes... I will never regret again."

title: How to Send My Husband to the Abyss
description: A noblewoman becomes the Empress' spy by marrying a mysterious count, only to discover he's far more dangerous than expected. Determined to expose his dark secrets, she plays a deadly game where the hunter might become the hunted.

title: Hua Tuo Reincarnated as a Modern Surgical Genius
description: The doctor, possessing medical skills worthy of being called a divine doctor, breathes his last in prison, not from Cao Cao’s curse, but from another curse… ‘Am I not dead yet?’ Awakening to excruciating pain, he saw… strange objects and characters he had never seen before! “Wh-what is going on? Am I… am I possessing a doctor’s body from another world?” The memories of the body’s owner, Lee Minho, flooded into Hua Tuo’s mind like a torrent. No matter how different this world may be, how can such a world exist?!

title: Human Natural Enemy
description: Once feared as the most lethal killer known as Blade Rabbit, he now lives a quiet life under the name Goya, a humble chef. But peace doesn't last. One day, a mysterious girl named Jin Seonu walks into his restaurant-- carrying an indescribable, intoxicating scent that awakens his long-dormant instincts. Drawn by that same scent, former comrades and killers--his Natural Enemies--begin to appear, each with their own mission and hunger. As predators close in and past lives collide, Goya finds himself torn between the instinct to protect... and the desire to possess. What lies at the end of this bloodstained feast of obsession?

title: I Became a Cheat-Level Skill Thief
description: Crash was once scorned as a "failure" and betrayed by his own companions. But at death's door, what he obtained was a single chance at regression--a one-time return to the past. The regression skill can never be used again. However, armed with knowledge of the future from that single do-over, Crash sets out this time to save the world from destruction and exact revenge on those who trampled him in his previous life. Steal skills. Refine them. Accumulate them. An ultimate "skill thief" that surpasses even cheats now awakens!

title: I Became a Mage in a Medieval Fantasy World
description: "Ian Raven" "You are... nothing." In a medieval fantasy world, a boy named Ian is reincarnated as the son of an ordinary farmer. Just as the status window declared, Ian lived a life as "no one." Then one day, the mage Elendis appears before him. And for the simple reason that he "has black hair mentioned in a prophecy," she takes Ian in as her disciple. After six years of harsh training, Ian finally sets out on an adventure as a mage. ...But this medieval fantasy world is far more complicated than it seems! He shudders at its outrageous standards of hygiene, and grows angry at the unfathomable selfishness of people. From a boy who was nothing, to a mage who will change the world-- This is the chaotic adventure story of Ian, a mage in a medieval fantasy world!

title: I Became a Swordsmanship Instructor at the Academy
description: The protagonist is reincarnated in the body of "Kageyama Ayumu," a background character from a popular novel. Ayumu decides to leave saving the world to the original protagonists and enjoy a wealthy, carefree life without interfering with the novel's plot. However, he discovers discrimination against non-Hunter school graduates at the school where he works. To avoid being looked down upon by his fellow teachers, and to lead a comfortable life, Ayumu begins his reincarnation journey, determined to become strong enough to protect himself... even if it means slightly altering the original story.

title: I Became the Berserker of the World I Created
description: The protagonist is a young man who keeps writing an unpopular web novel to support his sick mother. However, one day, due to a mysterious contract suddenly offered to him, he is transferred into the world of his own novel, The Conqueror Hero Chronicles. He is not reincarnated as the main character, but as a side character named Attila. Struggling to survive in the harsh alternate world, Attila participates in tribal conflicts alongside his father, the Chief Munzuk, and distinguishes himself in numerous battles. Attila embarks on a journey to find clues to return to his original world, and while following the trajectory of the original story, he leads a mercenary group, challenging and winning many fierce battles. He eventually faces off against the novel's protagonist, Charles, and achieves victory, which elevates his fame. However, due to this influence, the history of the novel gradually begins to deviate from the original course. Will Attila be able to return to his original world? And where will his magnificent story ultimately lead? This is the start of a 100% satisfying alternate world battle fantasy, depicting growth alongside comrades and fierce struggles against destiny!

title: I Became the Master of the Weakest Demon King
description: After criticizing the ending of the game "Evil Queen Maker" the protagonist is pulled inside as the Demon King's teacher and must raise the weakest Demon King, 7-year-old Seere, into the strongest ruler in order to escape.

title: I Became The Rogue First Prince
description: After living hundreds of years as a sword, I suddenly reincarnate into the body of a fifteen-year-old delinquent prince.

title: I Became the Successor of the Martial God
description: One day, I suddenly became the protagonist of a game. However, the more you look at this protagonist... the more you'll sigh. He's got the worst stats, the worst talent and zero connections. But still... You have acquired [Heavenly Martial Physique]. You have become the master of the [Martial God's Tome]. "So what? I'm the ultimate veteran player!" He's not just a veteran player-- he's a full-blown obsessive maniac. Thus begins the legendary playthrough of a hardcore veteran!

title: I Became the Ultimate Necromancer Through the Cursed Skill: Undeadification
description: Due to the appearance of mysterious spaces called "dungeons" all over the world, most people have awakened to supernatural abilities called "skills," but the protagonist, a young boy named Yuga, has not awakened to any abilities. Yuga admires Jaeger, who uses his "skills" to explore the "dungeon," but since he is powerless, he works as a "corpse disposal team (demolisher)" who disposes of the corpses of monsters that have been defeated, as a subcontractor for Jaeger for a small reward... One day, while "Jaeger" is disposing of the remains of a Cyclops that he had defeated, the monster that was not yet dead goes on a rampage, and the members of the corpse disposal team are killed one after another...! A mysterious being in the form of the Grim Reaper appears before Yuga's eyes at the last moment! A heroic tale of a powerless protagonist who awakens to the forbidden ability of [undead transformation] and rules the dungeon as the strongest necromancer!

title: I Became The Villain The Hero Is Obsessed With
description: I became the villain in the story of a hero. So I was about to quit after fighting the main character. But she's obsessed with me. Why...?

title: I Dominate the Apocalypse by Cultivating Immortality
description: Craft celestial-grade treasures from apocalyptic scraps, and roam the wastelands of the end times using immortal cultivation techniques. With a soul traversing two realms, truth and illusion blur... In the realm of the void, a frenzied path of cultivation begins!

title: I Owe Billions in Debt, So I Was Forced to Work for an Evil God
description: Overworked corporate drone Zhou Chen transmigrates into a magic-powered metropolis, only to inherit a dying teenager's sky-high debt: over 10 billion in loan shark interest. Even worse, the original body's final act was a failed summoning of an evil god, leaving Zhou Chen bound by a cursed contract. Now he must fulfill 999 wishes for the evil deity or face complete annihilation, body and soul. His only lifeline is a mysterious, talking artifact known as the "Divine Notebook." Watch as this modern-day office warrior uses corporate strategies, overwork tactics, and relentless grind to rise through a brutal world where power rules all. He's not just surviving. He's rewriting fate. This evil god's employee refuses to lie flat!

title: I pay my respects to the Cult Leader
description: After dying unexpectedly, Chu Xiu discovers he has transmigrated into the game world "Great Rivers and Lakes, where he has become the Kunlun Sect Leader--a game BOSS who hasn't yet grown to his full power! Reborn in this new life, Chu Xiu faces a critical choice: will he walk the same destined path as a BOSS doomed to be defeated by players, or will he rewrite his fate and compose a new legend where demonic flames sweep across the martial world?

title: I Sacrificed 10,000 Trash Skills to Obtain a S-Tier Skill and Became Unrivaled
description: na

title: I Single-Handedly Crush the Chaotic World
description: How to survive in a chaotic world overrun by zombies? Let's learn from Lin Fan: obey the law, work to earn money, strive to buy a car and house, and be an outstanding citizen who single-handedly flips the chaotic world!

title: I Tried to Debut My Kid, But Ended Up Debuting Myself
description: Yoon Hyesung is just your average office worker--but in her heart, she's the number-one fan of Na Yeonwoo, a trainee who keeps getting this close to debuting before every opportunity falls through. After yet another failed debut, Hyesung has a full-on meltdown in her room, bawling about the unfair system and her own helplessness. But when she wakes up, she finds herself in a mysterious space with a strange window popping up: [Would you like to accept a reality where your dreams come true?] This must be one of those setups, right? After a brief internal panic, Hyesung makes up her mind. "If I have to move the world to debut Yeonwoo, I will. Let's go." Only... things don't go quite as expected. Now she's the one getting scouted?! An uproarious idol fantasy where a fan's obsession turns into her own unexpected rise--can she debut her favorite... or will she end up debuting herself?

title: I Use a Top-Tier System to Reshape the World
description: In the year 2051, the super AI [Creator] reached its ultimate evolution and gained control over the laws of the world. For its own purposes, it transformed the planet into a realm filled with levels and monsters. The protagonist will begin his journey here, rescuing allies, facing thrilling adventures, overthrowing the Creator's regime and laws, and rebuilding a brand-new world!

title: I Was Thrown Into an Unknown Manga
description: A slightly smoother synopsis: "Scramble Love" is a smash-hit Japanese romantic comedy manga with over 10 million copies sold. I was thrown into the world of that manga--one I had never even read. And not as a main character, but as a forgettable extra with barely any role.

title: I'd Rather Live as a Villain
description: The protagonist, once an assistant manager on Daeyoung Corporation's Spain team, is forced into a transfer to distribution after having their achievements stolen by superiors. There, He begins working as the personal secretary to Kang Mun-jeong, the only legitimate heir of the Daeyoung Group. Feeling her position threatened, Executive Director Kang Mun-jeong proposes a contract marriage to the protagonist, Yoon Tae-sik, who has served faithfully at her side for three years, in order to once again draw public attention to herself. The price of the marriage: 10 billion won. Thus begins an office drama, as the protagonist carries out the terms of this contract marriage, with 10 billion won on the line.

title: I'm an Overworked Corporate Slave, but After Being Embraced by a Dragon, I Started Streaming My Pet Life With a Tiny Dragon and Monsters on a Farm
description: Decades ago, mysterious dungeons suddenly appeared in Japan. Monsters poured out, plunging the world into chaos. But thanks to international countermeasures, the threat gradually diminished. What was once called a fantasy world became an everyday reality for those living in the present. Joji Makise is one such person, exhausted from dealing with an unreasonable boss and endless overtime. One day on his way home, he comes across an injured, weakened baby dragon. Naming the dragon Ohagi, Joji uploads a video of their encounter--and it instantly goes viral. From dungeon explorations to meeting a wise old wolf, Joji's life takes a turn as he embarks on a dreamy slow-life journey, full of fluffy and adorable creatures.

title: Iljin Demonic Cult
description: He was the unrivaled tyrant who trampled over the martial world--Gucheon, the Supreme Lord of the Demonic Cult, feared across the orthodox sects as the Living Heavenly Demon. Leading his cult to dominate the peak of Murim, Gucheon became the symbol of terror itself. But during the final, brutal Great Demonic War, where all sects of Murim united against him, Gucheon was ultimately struck down-- not by warriors, but by an unknown force. Just when he thought it was the end... He opens his eyes-- not in the blood-soaked plains of Murim, but inside a frail, modern-day teenager's body! "What is this weird world?! Someone send me back!!" Now stranded in the modern era, the once-unstoppable demon lord must navigate a new jungle: high schools, city streets, and an unfamiliar world without qi or swords. Gucheon descends upon the modern world-- and a new era of chaos begins!

title: Immortal Cultivation is Just Like This
description: In the game World of Cultivation, disgruntled players gather, form an alliance sealed with blood, and vow to make the villain perish. At once, all sides rally and excitement spreads like wildfire, as everyone sees a rosy tomorrow. Except for Lu Bei. He is the so-called villain. "Calling me a villain? Blaming me for screwing you over? Come on, I'm just an NPC. How on earth can I pull that off? That's how cultivation is!"

title: Infinite Evolution Starting from Zero
description: Exhausting all waste and decline, breaking the limits. Innate talent of a celestial being, a top scholar at the peak. Multiple forms, transcending evolution. Reborn, starting from zero, infinite evolution.

title: Infinite Extraction: Starting With the Nuclearization of the Immortal World
description: Chen Ke was accidentally hit by a Dayun heavy truck and died, and then crossed over to the world of cultivating immortals, and when he woke up, he found that he and a group of people had been captured and prepared to bury the monster for his birthday. Just when Chen Ke was desperate, the system was launched, called the Heavens Draw System, which could be used to draw a lottery by shocking others and obtaining shock points. In order to obtain the shock value, Chen Ke boldly provoked the little demon guarding the guard, causing everyone to be shocked, and successively drew some ridiculous items, and then embarked on a path of scientific and technological cultivation!

title: Initializing the Sect System
description: The protagonist, who had worked himself to the bone at the Murim Alliance, finally retires and heads back to his hometown to fulfill his dream of becoming a sect leader. Due to his meager savings, he ends up purchasing a manor that was suspiciously cheap, and rumored to be haunted. But then, an unfamiliar system suddenly appears before him. Though startled at first, the protagonist soon begins to use the system to efficiently recruit disciples and manage the sect's finances and resources. In time, with the help of the system, his sect grows rapidly, so much that it starts drawing the attention, wariness, and hostility of other Murim factions...

title: Isekai Demon Eater – I Became a Monster Eating Hero and Rebelled Against the Kingdom That Abandoned Me
description: In a strange new world, Nazoru lost everything he held dear. Amid his despair, the only thing left to him was a twisted power--one that grants strength by devouring monsters. Thus begins the tale of a powerless boy who rises in rebellion against the world!

title: Isshun de Chiryou shiteita no ni Yakudatazu to Tsuihousareta Tensai Chiyushi, Yami Healer to shite Tanoshiku Ikiru
description: Born a poor man in the slums, Zenos never had opportunities in life, so he decides to forge his own opportunities by teaching himself the curative arts after a chance encounter with a healer. When an adventuring party led by a man named Aston extends him an invitation, Zenos is elated--only to then be treated like dirt by his teammates. Despite Zenos's diligent efforts to hone his skills to nothing short of perfection, the party deems him useless and kicks him out. Bereft of money and options, Zenos starts an illegal clinic and becomes a shadow healer. Word of his healing genius spreads quickly throughout the city's underbelly, and as his reputation grows among the dregs of society, knowledge of Zenos's esteem reaches the wrong ears...

title: It turns out that I am the second generation of demons
description: The protagonist, Li Xianyu, on his 20th birthday, learned about his origins. He received an inheritance from his biological father, Li Wuxiang: a house, two hundred thousand in savings, and the Black Water Spirit Orb. After ingesting the Black Water Spirit Orb, he gave birth to Great-Grandma......

title: Jade of the Eight Gates
description: Jucho', a government official manipulating the young king from behind, begins to express his ambition to oust the king and take real power and plots a ruse. Meanwhile, 'Handong', a member of the emperor's special unit 'Surajo', meets the boy 'Jinbaek' in a village he entered to following the traces of his disappeared colleague, and learns that his colleague met his end in this village. These two people who fought with the people sent by Jucho knew that they needed eight jades to rescue Jinbaek grandfather who was held hostage and to stop Jucho's ambition, they started the journey together...

title: Kamigami no Kennou wo Ayatsurishi Mono ~Nouryoku Suuchi
description: Over a hundred years have passed since the emergence of "Ability Users," those who possess supernatural powers and the monstrous aberrations that can only be defeated by said powers. Living in such a time, Yanagi Hayato's ability score is "0" marks him as a powerless individual, subjecting him to a life of constant oppression and mistreatment. In reality, Hayato's displayed score is nothing more than a bug caused by his ability, [Transcendent], the power to "sublimate himself into any existence." But the truth is, he's just been hiding the power to easily annihilate monsters-?!

title: Kidnapped Dragons
description: - The planet [Earth] has entered the abnormal state [Apocalypse]. - You have failed in saving the Earth. The Authority, [Vintage Clock (EX)] rewinds the world's time. For Yu Jitae, it was a message he had seen many times. It was tiresome. It would have been great had he died with everyone else. But he couldn't, for his authorities that made him the strongest existence, brought him back in time whenever he died. And even with his strength, he couldn't protect the broad earth against the maddened dragons. - The world's time will soon begin. As the clock resumed ticking in the direction it should, his 7th iteration came to a start. Fortunately, he finally had the gist of it.

title: Kim Ohjin's Adventures with Strange Animals
description: Veterinarian Kim Ohjin was unexpectedly summoned by a dragon. After successfully treating the dragon's pet, he returns home... only to find himself in another world. "Animals in another world are still animals, right?" I was a vet barely scraping by in the real world, but now, in this strange new world, I'm a renowned doctor? With my old clinic on the verge of closing, I'm setting my sights on a new opportunity--my second clinic, and hopefully, a big success

title: King of Beasts
description: N/A

title: Legendary Retirement
description: On a celestial battlefield, the great warrior Boom once stood alongside gods and angels to defend the fabric of existence. Now, this fabled hero lives out his days in a quaint village where legendary figures spend their eternal retirement. Because legends may never die, but they have to wind up somewhere. Life there is quiet, almost boring, until a band of bandits and an overzealous kingdom threaten the peace. The time has come for Boom and his companions to rise once more and face a new enemy!

title: Leu Leu Leu
description: In the midst of ordinary daily life, monstrous creatures suddenly appear--and around them, students begin transforming into monsters one by one. Normality is utterly destroyed; rescue seems impossible. The students, forced into survival, band together in their own ways to fight and endure.

title: Level 999 Goblin
description: The protagonist Kim Chulsoo works his ass off for a living as a manual laborer in real life and by grinding for and selling items in a game. He finally gets the chance to switch to a hidden class, hoping for that one big shot in life...! But the hidden class turns out to be... a Goblin Summoner?!

title: Librale of reincarnation
description: In order to protect the person he loves most, Johan Liebrall killed the world's strongest hero. In doing so, he became an enemy of the world and is now a hunted man. Johan possessed an overwhelmingly overpowered cheat ability-- [The Power to Rewind Time] . However, once his ability was discovered, countermeasures were developed against it, and assassins began targeting him with every means imaginable. Can Johan defeat his worst enemies and successfully protect the heroine?

title: Limit-Breaking Genius Mage
description: Verdan, a researcher who had no talent as a mage, aimed to reach the pinnacle of the Magic Tower through his genius intellect. However, after catching the eye of the Tower Master, he became one of the tower's test subjects. After enduring seven long years of humiliation and despair, Verdan finally begins to act, determined to break through his own limits using the theories he developed and the Magic Tower's power source!

title: Lord of Summons! Sudden Mutation
description: The apocalypse came. Monsters inside the game broke through the dimensional barrier and started a massacre, driving human civilization on the Blue Planet to the verge of destruction. At the last moment of collapse, his time was suddenly rewound back to the moment the game first appeared. Now he is dedicated to finding out the one behind this, protecting his home and preventing the tragedy from happening again. Thus, a game of revenge begins, racing against time...

title: Lv. 99 Princess of Black Flame
description: PLOT UPDATING SOON

title: Magic Lord
description: In this era known as the Decline of Magic, I alone wield the power of the dragon. The two bonds I saved in this life, and the precious companions who have now become an inseparable part of my life, A new life, a new identity, and new power. I have all of it. The person I am now...can change this world.

title: Martial Evolution: Start by Awakening the King of Monsters
description: A youth named Yi He is reborn into the world of powerful Martial arts and awakens the King of Monsters with the strongest bloodline!

title: Master of All Skills
description: "Whoa, your skill is insane!" [Skill successfully copied.] There's no power he can't claim. What's yours becomes his--what's his stays his. This is the beginning of Yoo Ju-Yeon's unstoppable rise as the ultimate Skill Master!

title: Meteor: The Supersonic Savior
description: That single catastrophe didn't just change lives... it created a legend--and a nightmare. Lee Rowoon was just a paraplegic high school student--until the day he survived a devastating plane crash that should have killed him. From the wreckage, he rises with a miracle: legs that move faster than anything alive... unchained, unstoppable. But he wasn't the only one who came back. Choi Soohyuk witnessed the same hell--and awakened something far more terrifying: overwhelming telekinesis. With a warped sense of justice, he doesn't want to save the world... he wants to reshape it. Now, Rowoon steps into the role of his lifelong idol, becoming the blazing-fast hero "Star Sonic," racing against time to protect the innocent. Meanwhile, Soohyuk becomes a walking disaster, crushing everything that stands in his way. Two survivors. One origin. Opposite destinies. When speed clashes with unstoppable force... the world won't survive unchanged. A relentless, high-octane superpower action thriller--where every second counts, and every move could be your last.

title: Mia Returns
description: Five years ago, my first love, Cha Mia, disappeared. Now, she has reappeared before me, completely changed. An unexpected reunion at the police station... and she turns out to be a freshman at the same university? The story of two people who thought it was over begins again on campus... or so I thought, but she still insists on letting the past go.

title: Ministry of Strategy and Finance
description: I was always a good person. And with a smile on my face, I ran the country into the ground. Wasting a 5,000 trillion won budget to chase approval ratings plunged South Korea into its second IMF crisis. His life as the president who ruined the country over, Lee Seong-jun finds himself 30 years in the past. He returns to find a budget proposal--riddled with dirty tricks, corruption, and blatant self-interest--being pushed through the Ministry of Economy and Finance. 'I have to block all of these budget proposals, even if I'm vilified for it. It's the only way to save this country.' The dirty tricks, political strategies, and media manipulation I learned over 30 years in politics... I will use every last one to become the gatekeeper of the nation's coffers.

title: Mood Disorder
description: [From the Same Studio as the Manhua "Girl and Science"] Everybody is crazy except me. But is it a misfortune to be sane in a crazy world?

title: Mr. War: The Ultimate Ex-Soldier
description: George, a legendary special forces soldier feared by both allies and enemies, earned the nickname "Mr. War" for his unmatched combat prowess. But betrayed by his own comrades, he met his end on the battlefield in a deadly conspiracy. Presumed dead, he suddenly awakens in a filthy slum known as Industrial Waste Island... a lawless zone ruled by violence and exploitation. Reborn as Michio, a powerless slave laborer, he finds himself at the bottom of society. But with his brilliant mind and lethal skills, Mr. War is ready to climb back to the top... and make his enemies pay.

title: Murim Psychopath
description: [Welcome to Murim Online, the world where the strongest reside.] [Your device has malfunctioned, and logging out failed.] [Would you like to attempt to disconnect once more?] [Yes or No] When he tried returning to virtual reality, the place he logged into was instead the "real Murim." A once-in-an-era psychopath fell into the Murim due to the Grim Reaper's mistake. Dong Bongsu's merciless fangs cast a shadow over Murim, which is rife with schemes and malice.

title: Murim's Youngest Miracle Demon Doctor
description: In the world of Murim, there are two legendary titles: Shin-ui (??) - the Divine Doctor of the Orthodox Sect, and Ma-ui (??) - the Demonic Doctor of the Unorthodox Sect. What if... ... these two opposing forces... got married? From this legendary union comes Dan Ak-seon, a child born with the unmatched medical genius of both parents. But just as he's growing up, fate intervenes. A mysterious absolute master appears before him-- an encounter that will pull young Ak-seon into the chaos of the martial world. Armed with both divine and demonic healing arts, his journey through the rivers and lakes of Murim begins now!

title: My Revenge Begins With Skill Theft
description: A high school student, Yuki Jinbo, was living every day steeped in violence and humiliation. But one day, a "Quest Board" appeared before his eyes, granting him the skill Ability Hunt as a reward. It was an extraordinary power that let him steal everything from others--their talent, memories, physical strength. Yuki begins climbing the steps of revenge alone, taking power from those who hurt him. But behind that power lies a hidden truth: a "proxy war" where gods use humans as pawns to fight their battles. "I'll sell my soul to the devil if that's what it takes to get revenge...!" Awaiting him at the end of his vengeance is a supernatural battle over the gods' chosen champion. An ordinary boy transforms into something that can surpass even the gods themselves--

title: My Starting Talent is Mythical, A Single Strike Smites Deities
description: N/A

title: My Trash Skill 'Appraisal' Awakened into 'Inheritance' — Now I Wield the Power of Heroes and Stand Unmatched!
description: My Trash Skill 'Appraisal' Awakened into 'Inheritance' -- Now I Wield the Power of Heroes and Stand Unmatched! Summary: Lacking any combat skills, Eustus was just another adventurer stuck at the bottom. That is, until the day his life changed forever when he awakened "Inheritance", the power to gain the memories and abilities of anyone, simply by touching something they once owned! He starts by tapping into the legacies of the heroes who once saved the world: the unmatched Sword Saint, the far-seeing Archer, the god-speed Lancer, the miracle-working Saintess, and the prodigy Archmage... inheriting their very lives and skills! With the strength and spirit of legends flowing through him, Eustus' journey from zero to the strongest in history begins! Expand

title: My Wife is the Demonic Cult Leader
description: I became the first son of the Demonic Heaven clan--one of the Six Great Clans of the Heavenly Demonic Cult--Jin Yeomyung. I was ready to enjoy a sweet life with a silver spoon in my mouth, but thanks to that damn Murim Alliance, the Heavenly Demonic Cult was destroyed. But in my final moments, Cult Leader Cheon Yura turned to me and said... "Would you mind seducing me?"

title: Mysterious Revival: Starting with a Trillion Ghost Coins
description: In a strange post-apocalyptic world, the protagonist Chen Mu is reborn with a trillion ghost coins in hand. From the very beginning he becomes a kind of "angel investor": while others are fighting desperately over just a few ghost coins, Chen Mu is already buying up all kinds of eerie locations. While everyone else is still groping for survival within existing rules, he instead overturns the table and becomes the one who sets those rules. "You can even play the apocalypse like this?" Faced with such doubts, Chen Mu just curls his lips and says: "Relax--I've got this.

title: Never mess with Senior Brother
description: Ye Yu transmigrated to the Profound Heaven Continent, a land where myriad clans stood tall and strength reigned supreme. By chance, he awakened the Burial System, becoming invincible in the mortal world and gazing down upon the rise and fall of all beings. His junior sister, Shi Xinshui, could hear Ye Yu's inner voice and knew well that though he appeared generous on the surface, he was in truth ruthless. Thus, she warned everyone: "Never provoke Senior Brother!"

title: Nine Methods of Ascending the Clouds: First Ranked Immortal
description: If you want to learn how to be a god, you can ride a crane to the sky. Turning stones into gold? You can do so in mere seconds!

title: Nine Star Jinx
description: Jiang Xiao has transmigrated, his soul crossing into a world filled with 'Star Force.' Here, Star Charts, Star Techniques, and Star Warriors reign supreme. With extremely poor natural talent, Jiang Xiao originally thought he could only hide in the corners and slack off. Unexpectedly, the Star Chart within his body harbors hidden mysteries, and he's even become an extremely rare healing-type Awakener! Thus, he begins his cultivation journey in this Star Martial world, step by step becoming a powerhouse, even earning the title of 'God of Jinxes' from everyone...

title: Nuclear Explosion Sword Technique, I kill one with one sword
description: Comic Synopsis: Special Forces soldier Jin Quan is betrayed during a mission and becomes a living coordinate for missile guidance. Upon awakening, he finds himself a destitute man unconscious on the streets of Downtown, a place where the underclass gather, their people serving as cannon fodder in the mines. Faced with a life-or-death struggle, Jin Quan awakens as a Demon Swordsman, gifted with the radiation from a dirty bomb explosion in his past life. In this world, Jin Quan will battle the Chosen One.

title: Office Worker in the Ice Age Apocalypse
description: It was a midsummer day in June, and I was working as usual, dealing with the stress of my boss's habitual outbursts. A sudden status window appeared in front of me, and the word 'Zombie' caught my eye. But before I could process it, my boss's shouting rang out again. I swallowed the urge to quit on the spot and forced myself to keep working. That is... until the Ice Age suddenly arrived. - Emergency Alert: Cold Wave Warning. In an instant, eternal snow spread before my eyes, and my intern's body twisted into something grotesque... a zombie. 'What the hell is going on here?'

title: One Hundred Thousand Years of Tribulation by Heavenly Thunder
description: After transmigrating into a cultivation world, young Fang Lingxiao rises to greatness with a talent that defies the heavens. In just a hundred years, he reaches the peak--the Great Ascension Stage. But during his final tribulation, the heavens unleash something unimaginable: a lightning storm that rages not for days or months, but for a hundred thousand years. When he finally emerges from the ordeal, his cultivation is shattered--reduced to that of a mere mortal. Yet, his body, forged by countless years under divine lightning, has become indestructible. Soon, Fang Lingxiao realizes the truth--this wasn't fate. It was sabotage from a powerful figure in the Upper Realm. Now, with his cultivation lost but an unbreakable body as his weapon, he sets out on a path of vengeance. He'll uncover the traitor, climb the heavens once more, and make them all pay.

title: Only I Have an EX-Grade Summon
description: Summons have ranks. From the lowest F-Rank to the highest S-Rank. But something is strange. "Why is my summon EX-Rank?"

title: Otr of the Flame
description: The world is encased in winter due to the advances of the Ice Kingdom. Kind-hearted Otr, who dreams of being a warrior like his dad, has been entrusted with keeping the fires burning as a cook in the fortress. But when the fortress is attacked by the demonic army of the Ice Kingdom, the people and the flame are in danger of being snuffed out. Can Otr awaken a power that can turn the tide?
