A hero's journey of fire and ice now begins! (MANGA Plus)

title: Part-Time Grim Reaper
description: "I'm from the afterlife." Lee Do-jin needs money--a lot of it--to cover his younger sibling's medical bills. With nowhere else to turn, he calls the number on a strange, ominous business card he finds by chance. At the meeting point, he encounters a silver-haired woman shrouded in mystery-- a grim reaper, known as a Chasa. She makes him an unbelievable offer: Work as a temp worker for the Underworld. His mission? To stop "Mokdugi," predators that feast on souls tainted by sin, before they can drag the damned into chaos. Thrust into the supernatural world of death, debt, and spiritual battles, Do-jin must navigate his new double life-- balancing his humanity with a job that demands he walk the line between life and death.

title: Physics Of The Wasteland
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, some humans gained special powers. Ayato, once a low-ranking nobody, survives an assassination attempt and rises amid chaos. He teams up with a healer girl and fights off mutated beasts called Chimera. However, powered humans can no longer reproduce. To save humanity, Ayato and his allies battle the odds--and finally create a cure to restore hope for the future. More In

title: Player Elimination Plan! When Anomalies Descend Upon The Human World
description: The apocalypse prophecy has come true. A dark celestial body draws near, turning the entire Blue Star into a doomsday game. All of humanity has been reduced to NPCs--helpless prey for players from beyond the stars. As the world mutates and players run rampant, despair consumes mankind... Until Yun Qi awakens a hidden class, gaining the power to strike back against the players.

title: Player Hellish Situation
description: Bai Zhi woke up to find he had transmigrated. Not only was there no System to help, but he'd also inexplicably gained 7 Ex-girlfriends? With an innocent look on his face, Bai Zhi raised the Club in his hand, glanced at the fearful Weird Ones surrounding him who didn't dare approach, and sighed: I knew this world was dangerous--thankfully, I'm a Shuraba Player!

title: Prepaid Dragon King Tanks Everything!
description: You ate me, so at least give me some kind of compensation, yeah?!" Dragon King: "Fine! I'll give you a prepaid cultivation technique--comprehend it first, then catch up with the training later!" Me: "You think that's enough?! I had to smell your nasty dragon breath--mental damage times two, buddy!" Dragon King: "What do you want from me?!" Me: "From now on, we're like immortals sharing a single health bar. All the damage? You take it!" Dragon King: "Damn it! You lunatic! Why does my ten-thousand-war-chariots-level HP bar feel so short now?! Guess it's time to get a job..."

title: Primordial Ten Fiends: Others Tame Beasts, I Tame Beast Girls
description: After three years of lying low, Lin Han awakened the Beast Taming System and gained ten ultra-fierce beast girls! Tearing apart enemies by day and taming beast girls by night, he was directly drained by them into becoming the pinnacle of global combat power

title: Project Mars
description: As a child, he lost his family in a brutal alien attack. Now, he lives a quiet life, hiding a secret power--the ability to control black holes. But when the aliens return and attack the city, he's forced to face them again. His life is in danger... and so is the world. "I'm sorry... but I can't die. Not after everything I've survived." Will he keep hiding--or use his power to fight back?

title: Raising Villains the Right Way
description: I, a corporate slave, ended up possessing the body of a noble inside a game, but I'm supposed to be an extra fated to be killed by the future villains? No way. I'll reform those brats and live out my noble life in peace! To stop the young villains from turning evil, I sponsored them and helped them overcome their harsh circumstances, and they all grew up to be admirable, upstanding, perfectly normal individuals as a result. And that's how I ended up becoming the final boss of the kingdom... ...Wait, what?

title: Ranker Game ~BASKETBALL SHOW~
description: PLOT UPDATING SOON

title: Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead
description: After being transported to another world and becoming the most powerful necromancer, Rhode unexpectedly finds himself back in his youth. In his original world, he was the good-for-nothing young master of the Morris family-a spoiled noble in everyone's eyes. Little does anyone know that he has brought back with him the unique necromantic magic he mastered in the other world. As Rhode works to regain the full power he once possessed as a necromancer, he hides his true strength and begins turning the tables on those who underestimate him. His family, loved ones, and friends... Given a second chance at life, this time he will protect everything that matters to him and completely rewrite the fate of both himself and those he holds dear!

title: Reborn as a Doomed Demon Lord? But I'm a Full-Strategy Streamer!
description: The top gaming livestreamer suddenly wakes up as a powerless Demon Lord with zero combat ability! Want to unlock cheat powers? First, he has to defeat his own subordinates. But with no strength -- not even enough to beat a chicken -- how can he turn the tables and survive in this brutal world?

title: Reborn in a Cyber Cultivation World, I Fight My Way to the Top
description: In the era of the "new Divine Land," the old sects stand on the brink of annihilation, crushed under the heel of the cyber-enhanced New Sects. Ling Chen, a disciple of the fading Fortune Sect, witnesses his brethren and father humiliated and slaughtered in the New Sects' ruthless purge. Swearing vengeance, he clings to life... until the latent power of his sect's forbidden skills, the "veiled skills," awakens within him. At death's door, Ling Chen becomes the perfect vessel for the primordial True God of Time. Reborn with the wrath of the ancients and the might of a god, he returns to the continent drenched in blood. His path is clear: Carve a new epoch from the corpses of the New Sects.

title: Red Shirt
description: The legend of the killer company, Cha Si-hyuk. He decides to retire after meeting the woman he loves, but the company has no intention of letting him go easily. Eventually, everything starts to be taken away from him, and Cha Si-hyuk takes up the sword again. Revenge begins, and the war with the huge organization 'Neville' becomes unavoidable... What will be left at the end of the sword of revenge?

title: Reincarnated as the Strongest Monster Eater: Revenge on the Tyrant Dragon
description: In this world, monsters are violent and dangerous. People hunt them for safety or for materials like hides and claws, but their meat is considered disgusting and never eaten. Ignoring this common belief, an odd adventurer named Maron cooks and eats monsters. A mysterious man, who lost his companions, hometown, and family to a dragon in the past, enters a dungeon to show unmatched strength and pursue a flavorful path of revenge.

title: Reincarnation of the Fist King
description: Dan Woosung, a man who once roamed the murim relying solely on his fists, met his sudden end at the hands of the demonic faction. He then finds himself in the body of the eldest son of an affluent merchant group named Eunha. "I don't seek freedom from debts or grudges. Debts must be repaid. Grudges must be settled." Though his new body offered only wealth, Dan Woosung rises again, backed with vast riches and the martial prowess of his previous life. Now, he returns to the path of vengeance.

title: Reincarnation of the Martial God
description: Betrayed and slain by those he once called allies, the legendary Martial God Seon Hwayoon is reincarnated as a prince of the Solar Palace. In his past life, he built an empire of justice, only to be murdered by his sworn brother and trusted comrades. Now reborn, he sharpens the blade of vengeance to reclaim his honor and exact revenge on those who betrayed him.. The age of reckoning begins.

title: Reincarnation of the Online Game Addict ~ I Can't Use the Overpowered Fists That Made Me the Fist King, so Now I Swing a Club for Eight Hours a Day
description: N/A

title: Resurrection Boy
description: A boy with a Resurrection Heart. Not even hundreds of deaths could kill him. Now, Jio sets his sights on the research lab that suppressed him and his friends their entire lives.

title: Return From The Abyss
description: "I shall wait for you at the edge of the Abyss..." That is what a mysterious man said to Sora Mukujima in one of his dreams. Sora lived a modest life together with his parents, until one day, that peaceful life fell apart. A massive tower appeared. His brother, a soldier, was unreachable. And monsters began to attack suddenly. When he was in a desperate situation, the man from his dream appeared before him. And when he woke up next, he was in an unfamiliar place. It was a different world called the "Abyss", just as the man had called it in his dream. In order to return to his original world and save his family, Sora vows to challenge the Abyss, fight, and grow stronger at all costs!

title: Return of the Adopted Child in a World of Bloodline Supremacy
description: In a world where worth is measured by bloodline, and magic is a privilege hoarded by the nobility, hope was born in the lowest of places... When the Demons invaded, the illusion of noble supremacy shattered. Their magic--once thought absolute--proved useless against the tide of destruction. Cities fell, screams echoed across the land, and humanity stood on the brink of extinction. But within that despair... rose someone who was never meant to bow. Colin--a former slave--carved his path with nothing but his blade, rising to become the strongest swordsman the world had ever known. And in his final moments, as death closed in, fate placed a miracle in his hands... the "Forbidden Grimoire"--a cursed tome that grants magic to anyone, even those denied it all their lives. He opened his eyes... Only to find himself five years in the past--once again a powerless boy, but now carrying memories of ruin... and power no longer out of reach. This isn't just a second chance. It's a declaration of war. This time, Colin won't repeat his mistakes. He won't stand by and watch the world crumble. He will break the rules, defy fate, and rise beyond the limits of both sword and sorcery. A blade in one hand... and magic in the other... The Magic Swordsman has been reborn. And this time... he will decide how the story ends.

title: Return of the Apocalypse-Class Death Knight
description: Damian Haxen was a man born with a talent destined to go down in history. However, he was transformed into a Death Knight by a dark mage, Archlich Dorgo, and was forced to live like a slave. By the archlich's command, he slaughtered his family with his own hands and brought ruin to every kingdom. Just as the entire world was about to fall under the archlich's control, Damian regained his consciousness, but it was already too late. Right when he was ready to give up everything, a miracle happened. Regression. Now back to the time before it all began, his goal was clear. "This time, I'll live only for my family's happiness and future. Of course..." He would purge all traces of the filthy dark mage and make him taste hell first!

title: Return of the First Patriarch: The Strongest Reincarnates into His Descendant 1000 Years Later
description: Gilphas Eldragon, the founding patriarch of the Eldragon family, dedicated his entire life to the pursuit of absolute strength. In search of eternal combat, he consumed a legendary fruit rumored to grant immortality under the protection of the divine dragon. Yet the rumor was false--Gilphas aged, and in the end, passed away in his son's arms. Or so it seemed. When he next opened his eyes, Gilphas found himself reborn a thousand years later as Zeke Eldragon, heir to his own bloodline. But the world had changed: the Eldragon clan now thrived under a ruthless creed of survival of the fittest, and a new threat known as the "Chaos" loomed over humanity. Faced with an unfamiliar era and even greater enemies, the ancient warrior feels only exhilaration. For Gilphas--now Zeke--this is the chance he longed for: "This time, I will witness the true end of martial strength!"

title: Return of the Immortal Monk
description: "He eats poison instead of food three times a day... and still won't die?" An immortal monk who couldn't die no matter how hard he tried -- finally meets his end... or so he thought. Reborn as a third-rate bodyguard in a brothel in Shandong, he finds that his powerful martial arts still lie dormant within him. Amidst chaos in the martial world, political strife for the throne, and enemies from his past life returning -- Cheongpung must fight once again to reclaim his power. Will he be able to reclaim his martial arts from his immortal monk days -- and finally reach Nirvana? The legend of the immortal monk begins anew!

title: Returning Student
description: Im Cheol, who was a legend in middle school, returns to school to seek revenge after learning that his friend Kim Sol, committed suicide due to school violence. However, his revenge is disrupted when Seo Ha-Yoon, who was like an older sister to him in the orphanage, is assigned to the same school as his teacher.

title: Revenge of the Unrivaled Streamer
description: In a modern world where there are doors that lead to "dungeons" and "Awakened People" fight to conquer them, the powerless protagonist, Akagi Enma, supports his awakened sister Ayumi who streams her dungeon raids. One day, the siblings are attacked by unknown assailants. When Enma regains his consciousness, the first thing he sees is Ayumi's lifeless body, brutally murdered... Seething with rage and a thirst for revenge, a mysterious demon called Vox suddenly appears before him. Determined to do whatever it takes to get revenge, Enma makes a contract with Vox and obtains a unique ability: "the more he is flamed, the stronger he becomes." In order to hunt down the man who killed his sister, Enma makes a name for himself as a "cancel-worthy" streamer by dealing with the evil the law cannot touch and runs rampant that is found in the dungeons.

title: Revenge of the wrongly accused
description: Gaku Tojo was cast into the depths of hell for a crime he didn't commit. Branded a murderer for a crime he had no part in, he was thrown behind bars. Even his parents, who fought tirelessly to prove his innocence, were murdered in a cold-blooded scheme orchestrated by the mastermind behind it all. On the brink of despair, he embraced a "madness" born of survival. Unfazed by the brutal torment within the prison walls, he retaliated with ruthless precision. His cold-blooded courage eventually transformed him into a figure feared by every inmate. --And then, he breaks free. After a life-or-death prison break, Gaku begins to uncover the truth behind his parents' deaths and the full extent of the frame-up that ruined his life. Who was the real killer behind that case? Will Gaku Tojo sacrifice everything to finally have his revenge...?!

title: Rise of the Devourer
description: Noah Brown has a gift for fighting. Unfortunately, punching things doesn't pay his bills. At least, that was the case until he dies and an Eldritch god finds his soul. The strange encounter brings him to a new world, summoned by bloody cultists. He's got nothing but the shirt on his back and a strange item of unknown power he isn't yet sure how to use. If he wants to survive, maybe even thrive, perhaps it's time he finally put his gift to good use. Art by Kisai Entertainment.

title: Rise of the Sect Master
description: Bai Yu wakes up to find that he has transmigrated and become the head of the Baiyu Sect. He soon discovers that any items he gifts to his disciple will be returned to him by the system in a hundredfold, thousandfold, and even more. With the help of this system, Bai Yu gradually earns the respect of those who once looked down on him.

title: S-Class Butler
description: Butler Kim is the raid leader of the VR game Metariaand in real life the guardian of two cats. One day, a mysterious boss forces him into the unwanted Butler class, where he must serve monsters and do menial chores. Just as he begins adjusting to this strange new role, an unbelievable truth is revealed: "A cat... logged into the game?!" His beloved pet Peechu has entered Metaria. But Peechu is not just Peechu. The "Master" who reclassified Butler Kim and has been giving him orders is actually Kalinas, the Incarnation of Darkness, now trapped inside the cat's body. With the world's balance at stake, Butler Kim is tasked with carrying out Kalinas's dark mission. Yet instead of worrying about the will of darkness, is he simply happy to adventure through a fantasy world with Peechu?

title: S-Class Hunter Heals with Monsters
description: For decades, I was a mindless Chimera Hunter--a weapon forged and discarded. But after dying in the depths of a monster-infested gate, I woke up... human. Now, as Cheon Dowoon, I just wanted peace--a quiet life, a warm cup of tea, and zero demonic nonsense. Too bad fate had other plans. First, a lost hellhound dug up my garden. Then, a snarky shadow beast started napping on my porch. Worst of all? My old "acquaintances" keep showing up--some begging for help, others... for my head. Revenge? Survival? Please. I just want to put on pants first. --A former killing machine's "relaxing" second life begins... in a front yard that's basically monster daycare.

title: Sandmancer of the Scorched Desert
description: [By the Author that brought you Legend of the Northern Blade and Reaper of the Drifting Moon!] "My name is Zeon. My weapon is the entire desert." Earth was forcefully terraformed. The oceans evaporated, and the land turned to sand. Zeon is the only sand mage left on this desertified Earth. The world calls him the "Sand Wraith."

title: Secret Family
description: A 17-year-old named Kang Geon transfers to an elite high school attended only by the top 0.1% of South Korea.Trained since the age of five in North Korea as a human weapon and a genius secret agent, he's given a mission to infiltrate South Korea's high society and build connections.But making friends turns out to be the bigger challenge.Living under the guise of a family with his father, a hacker watched by nations, and his mother a legendary assassin, he navigates a spy-action drama in search of true happiness.

title: Sha-MONEY-ism
description: "True first-class shamans play in Yeouido." In Korea's financial district of Yeouido, investment firms rake in billions by employing real shamans who can foresee stock movements. These firms have become the stage for elite spiritual power brokers. Chun Ji-seung, a poor boy, is scouted as a shaman who can curse stock prices using dark rituals. His unique ability propels him into the cutthroat world of high finance, where money and mysticism collide. This is the story of his rise through the bizarre world of corporate exorcism and stock market sorcery.

title: Sisters-in-law, I'm Really Not Stupid Anymore
description: After pretending to be a stupid for five years, I struck back and annihilated my enemies, rising to the peak! Now that the truth is revealed, it's my turn to protect all of you for the rest of your lives!My entire family of ten was slaughtered, and now seven stunning women insist on marrying me?

title: So, Did Someone Force You to Become the Heavenly Demon
description: A ninth-grade civil servant, Seo Jihoon, only ever wished for a long, quiet, and peaceful life. But after being fatally stabbed by a violent petitioner, the place where he opened his eyes again was none other than a martial world where martial arts truly existed. Even there, he only wanted to live quietly… Until he encountered the one man he should never have crossed paths with. “Choose. Die here, or become my disciple.” An old man who pressed a blade to his throat without warning. His true identity, the cult leader of the Heavenly Demon Sect. Thinking survival comes first before anything else, Seo Jihoon had no choice but to become part of the Heavenly Demon. Once a capable public servant, he grew into an unrivaled talent within the sect, armed with powerful martial arts and sharp intellect. But why does the work keep piling up? Why does he keep getting promoted?! His original goal was simply a peaceful life, yet somehow, his second life is racing down the path of the Heavenly Demon. Will he ever be able to find the life he truly desires in this world?

title: Spirit Realm Wanderer
description: Since time immemorial, it has been said that there exists a Spirit Realm. Throughout the dynasties, renowned scholars and literati have spoken of it in various ways, and a poem records: "From Qi to Tang, this mountain grew desolate, the Spirit Realm lay silent, seldom visited by man. The Spirit Realm cannot be described, its ghostly craftsmanship is hard to seek."

title: Starting With 13 Hidden Traits
description: In a world where the game and reality are becoming one, this is the story of a man who starts with 13 hidden traits.

title: Stella, the Princess Who Will Never Die
description: Princess Stella, the princess of the Hill Valley Kingdom, who lost her father, the king, is in the middle of a battle for succession. After receiving a will that leaves the throne and most of the king's fortune to Stella, her sister-in-law Ishjia plots to assassinate Stella. However, every attempt to assassinate Stella ends in failure. Ishjia finds this puzzling, but then she notices something strange happening to Stella's body... (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Super Hero: Black Friday
description: The only superhuman with overwhelming power, "Friday," has appeared! Because of this single hero, Earth now teeters on the brink of apocalypse. In the end, will it be Friday who destroys humanity-- or will humanity's own dark nature bring about its downfall?

title: Super Magic Academy's SS Rank Freshman
description: An admission letter without a senders name forced Xiao Lin into a mysterious school called Dawn Academy. Here, learning to perceive elements and mastering swordsmanship are the basics, while concocting lethal or life-saving potions is a required course. As for the real core curriculum, it's far stranger than he ever imagined..

title: Supreme Academy Genius
description: Shuichi was born in modern society as an ordinary high school student. After losing his father, he struggled desperately to protect his mother and sister, but was brutally bullied at school and even lost his life in an unexpected accident. However, when he woke up, he found himself reborn as Lucas Ryan, a noble boy from another world! It seems that Lucas once incurred the wrath of the magic god and died without being granted magic. Shuichi's soul resides in Lucas's body, and at the same time, he receives the blessing of Mars, the god of war! However, in this world, magicians are revered and martial artists are looked down upon. Reborn as Lucas, he would rather not live a life of despise by those around him--that's the last thing he wanted! Shuichi will master martial arts as Lucas and seize glory with his fists.

title: Surviving the Inverted World with Omnipotent Skills
description: The world's most popular game, AZURE LAND, suddenly ends its service. Soon after, monsters from the game begin appearing in the real world, blurring the line between reality and virtual reality. Shizuya Kakitsubata, the game's top commander, is caught in the chaos and must now fight to survive. Humanity, once the hunters, have become the hunted--and their survival is uncertain in this new, deadly reality

title: Sword-Devouring Swordmaster
description: Arhan Karavan lost everything he had to a swordmaster without even knowing why. Amidst the death-like despair, Arhan only had one way to get revenge... "Devour swords and make the power that lies within yours." ...thus began his tale of vengeance. The forgotten family name "Karavan" will resound once more.

title: The 100 Curses of House Illeston
description: As if being reincarnated into a generic fantasy webtoon wasn't enough, I have to be the 'Necromancer' who is sacrificed for the protagonist... Since it has come to this, it can't be helped. Even if I can't become a rich noble lady from a romance fantasy, I want to at least protect my life and live comfortably. Let's go to that place, the one full of curses and ghost stories. To the mansion of the villain, Archduke Illestone! "I will break the curse on this mansion for you. In return, please raise me."

title: The Absolute's Modern Life
description: The hunter "Choi Kang-ho," once called a TR5 hero, loses his precious partner at the end of the Great War. After his partner's death, an egg is left behind in their place. Carrying that egg carefully, he disappears from the eyes of the world. Exactly 30 years later, at January 1st, 00:00, "Seol-a" is born from his partner's egg. And once again, ominous signs begin to appear. To protect the peace and raise Seol-a well, the Absolute of Cheorwon begins his modern life.

title: The Abyssal Game Architect
description: N/A

title: The Almighty Trap Master
description: A world that suddenly transforms into a dungeon-- Tsukasa Ninomiya, a young man aspiring to become a Hunter, awakens to an S-rank job within the dungeon: "Trap Master," a class that dominates all traps. Those who control traps are virtually invincible inside a dungeon. Using his abilities, Ninomiya seizes complete control of the terrain, annihilating monsters through devastating chains of traps--flames, massive boulders, chainsaws, and more. "I'll set it for you. A death trap straight to hell--Death Trap!" An over-the-top, exhilarating, one-man domination battle action story begins as he charges toward becoming the strongest in the world!

title: The Art Student Who Lived Twice
description: Lee Jae-ha dreamed of becoming a successful designer-- but just as things were looking up, he was falsely accused of plagiarism and his world came crashing down. "If only I could start over... like in those web novels..." And in the blink of an eye, he does. He opens his eyes and finds himself 10 years in the past, back in art school, with all his memories and work experience from the future intact. Now armed with both a second chance and real-world wisdom, Jae-ha is determined to do it all differently: Build a name for himself on campus Land a job before anyone else And most importantly, clear his name once and for all No more regrets. No more failures. This time, he'll paint his own masterpiece of a life.

title: The Back-Alley Mage's Return
description: "One day, a wyvern flew overhead. The moment I saw it, I decided to retire." Aster, once a notorious troublemaker from the slums, clawed his way into the esteemed mage family--House Declan. But craving freedom, he fled... only to be hunted down and killed. When he opens his eyes again, he's back in the slums, caught in the hazy border between life and death. "This time, I'm going to build a library--no, a tower! Just like my old comrades dreamed of." "And for good measure, I'll display the Declan family's secret spellbook right on the first floor."

title: The Berserker's Second Playthrough
description: The protagonist, having possessed a berserker character within the game, has finally slain the Great Demon and cleared the ending after many events. He believed that was the end. However, before his eyes was not an exit to the real world but a [New Game+] button to start another run.

title: The Black-Haired U.S. Army General
description: In 1911, the first Korean cadet enrolled at the United States Military Academy

title: The Bottom-Feeder Scavenger's Revenge
description: After the death of his sister, Low, who had always been known as a hanger-on, becomes an explorer to investigate the circumstances surrounding her death. When he nearly loses his life in a dungeon, he acquires a mysterious ability to dismantle (disassemble) the corpses of monsters, supplies, and even skills. By breaking down various things, Low grows stronger. Gradually, the mystery behind his sister's death also begins to unravel...

title: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows (MangaToon)
description: Born a poor man in the slums, Zenos never had opportunities in life, so he decides to forge his own opportunities by teaching himself the curative arts after a chance encounter with a healer. When an adventuring party led by a man named Aston extends him an invitation, Zenos is elated -- only to then be treated like dirt by his teammates. Despite Zenos's diligent efforts to hone his skills to nothing short of perfection, the party deems him useless and kicks him out. Bereft of money and options, Zenos starts an illegal clinic and becomes a shadow healer. Word of his healing genius spreads quickly throughout the city's underbelly, and as his reputation grows among the dregs of society, knowledge of Zenos's esteem reaches the wrong ears.

title: The Chairman of Pharmaceutical Company is a Poison King
description: 300 years later... On an Earth shrouded in mana. I was a 'Mana Rejector'--someone for whom that very mana was a deadly poison. Then one day, as I was waiting for death, unable to even Awaken...I connected with an identical soul from another dimension. The soul of the Absolute Ruler of the Murim... The Absolute Poison Demon, Dang Gunak

title: The Chosen SSS-Rank
description: On October 31st, 2024, the Great Cataclysmhappned. Ever since, the world has turned into a hell swarming with grotesque monsters. The only ones capable of fighting back were the Chosen Ones, those who possess superhuman powers. K, an S-Rank Chosen One, fought life-and-death battles against the monsters as a dog hired by the organization. However, in one such battle, he loses his life... But when K, who was supposed to be dead, awakens, he finds himself in the body of a baby. What's more, time has rewound to the year 2020! Somehow, he had been reincarnated 4 years before the "Great Cataclysm" occurred! To stop the impending doom, K once again confronts his destiny!

title: The Clan's Failure Was Once the Continent's Strongest
description: "Is this... hell?" Bakuto Yaemori, once called the strongest on the continent, is suddenly betrayed by his comrades and dies filled with regret. When he opens his eyes again, he sees people staring at him with puzzled expressions. Bakuto Yaemori has been reborn as a university student from a prestigious family. However, this new Bakuto has a weak body and is ostracized by his clan--even bullied by his classmates. With the pride of being "the strongest in his previous life" burning in his chest, Bakuto begins training once more. He vows revenge against those who betrayed him and resolves to reclaim his position as the strongest. But troubles keep piling up around him one after another... Thus begins an exhilarating revenge story of the strongest warrior possessing the weakest body! Genre: Reincarnation fantasy, Revenge, Weak-to-strong progression, Academy setting

title: The Cloud Dream of the Nine - Zero
description: What if The Dream of Nine Clouds was just the title--and nothing more? 20-year-old Yang Soyu is an ordinary Korean man... until the day he's summoned to another world. No status windows, no cheat skills--just guts, grit, and a world full of dragons. With nothing but his will to survive, Soyu rises through the chaos and hunts down a dragon. But when he finally returns to Earth, nothing is quite the same. This isn't the world he left behind-- This is just the beginning of a modern action-fantasy with zero limits

title: The Cold-Blooded Warrior
description: Han Jaewoo is a sweat in the world-famous game "Savior Of Humanity." Once a hardcore player, now drowning in debt in his tiny room. His long-awaited showdown with a demon lord ends in an unexpected failure. The debt collectors are closing in... and all that's left to him are despair and stubborn grit. That's when Aquila, the administrator, appears with an offer: "Don't you want to see it? The true happy ending of this game..." With a prize of 25 million dollars on the line, and the path to the true ending finally revealed, he accepts it. However, there's a catch: He's thrown back into the game world with all his stats reduced to rock bottom. "Thanks for the "realism," Aquilla... Screw it. I'm clearing this damn thing!"

title: The Concept-Grasping Magical Genius
description: Pauline became a mother figure to Rowan, who had lost everything. After Pauline left, Rowan grieved her and awakened to a power called 'Mana'. What's more, Rowan could even see the Mana of other people! Through mana, even though he's apart from Pauline, he can always feel like she's with him... One day, Rowan encounters a shocking sight of Pauline, who he believed had left for a noble family.

title: The Dan Family's Good-For-Nothing Is Too Strong
description: Ju Hong-mun, a low-ranking warrior who secretly learned the secret martial arts techniques of the Dan family. However, he crumbles helplessly before the Black Flame Cult's attack, and ultimately meets his death while lamenting his lowly status. ...But when he opens his eyes?

title: The Dark Mage ~ I am the Only Transcendant Mage who Regressed with Cheat Skills
description: suddenly appeared around the world, resulting in the awakening of humans. Those who possess skills are called [Colored], meanwhile those who are excellent are granted the title of . Kurosaki Rei, who has no skills, is discriminated and called . Compared to him, his brother who is recognized as the . Regardless, Rei couldn't give up his dream to become a . 10 years after the first appearance of the the , a powerful entity emerged and threatened to destroy the whole world. The entity is known as the . Against the overwhelming power of the god, Rei had awakened a skill called , and then stole the power of the god....! Using this new power, he gained the power to fight against the time itself and flew into the past to start over everything.

title: The Dark Swordsman Returns
description: On a battlefield at the brink of annihilation, unknown soldier Gray Lee had his chest pierced through--and he awaited death. Only humanity's strongest heroes--the Sword Saint, the Divine Archer, the Great Sage, and the Ultimate Shield--stood a chance against the "Liquidator," a deadly enemy capable of burning down an entire continent in a single day. Yet even those heroes fell, one by one, until all hope was lost... ...At least, that's what it should've been. "I got pierced through the heart, but I'm still alive?" Gray did not die. Instead, he was guided by Chronos, the Master of Time. He was bestowed an unknown power, and with it he delivered a powerful blow to the Liquidator, shaking the threads of fate itself. But just as a chance of victory appeared, another beam of light struck, Gray's body reducing to nothing... ...and Chronos's voice thundered, "I shall send you to the past. Save this world." The next thing Gray knew, he woke up in his hometown, which should long have been destroyed. It was the place he started his life of a loser--and was now the stage for his second chance. "This time, I will survive!" With the power to transcend time and his memories of the future, Gray sets out to become a warrior even stronger than the heroes.

title: The Demonic Cult Instructor Returns
description: The Central Plains fell to the invasion of the Demon Realm. A martial artist, Sa Bigang, was ultimately dragged into that infernal world. After surviving the brink of death and enduring hell itself, he awakens ten years before the invasion ever began. And now, Sa Bigang sets out to stop the Demon Realm's return. To do that, he must restore order to the murim and build the ultimate force: the Undefeatable Corps. As the man who will rewrite the past and safeguard the future... This time, he will never lose.

title: The Detective's Demonic Chronicles
description: A bizarre case of sudden death shakes the city of Tendoku. All signs point to a mysterious drug known as "Faust." As detective Subaru Shizuhara and officer Sumire Natsuno delve deeper into the investigation, they uncover a terrifying truth: everything is part of a ritual to summon a demon into this world. But then, Sumire realizes something even more horrifying-- a demon is hiding... inside Subaru.

title: The Devil's Advocate: Hell's Ruthless Prosecutor
description: Isaku Honjo is a cold-hearted prosecutor who will fabricate evidence if that is what it takes to see criminals punished. One day, he dies in an unexpected accident together with his wife and daughter and falls into Hell. There, a "Millennial Festival" held by demons is underway. The demon Bune singles Isaku out as a candidate to serve as his "devil's proxy" and offers him a contract: if he participates in the festival and obtains the legendary Ring of Solomon, any wish will be granted--he and even his family can be brought back to life. Forming the contract, Isaku throws himself into the Millennial Festival as Bune's agent, wielding the sword of judgment against demons themselves. Will he succeed in claiming the Ring of Solomon? A top-tier dark fantasy about a star prosecutor who now passes sentence on devils in the depths of Hell.

title: The Eldest Son of the Marquis House is a Martial Artist
description: In a fantasy world in a novel, I am the only one using martial arts.

title: The Eternal Support Mage Becomes the Strongest Sage
description: Thor, a former hero's party member, teaches unpopular support magic at a magic university--until saving a student gets him fired. With nowhere else to go, he follows that very student, Reina, to the empire next door, where a princess hires him as a court magician.Though he underestimates himself, Thor's support magic is actually extraordinary, and his former students are already achieving greatness worldwide. Determined to at least look cool in front of them, the "useless" teacher begins his new life, unwittingly as the strongest sage.

title: The Eunuch's Second Life
description: "Jang Jinmyeong", a martial arts master who mastered the forbidden technique "Gyuhwa Bojeon", reached the peak of power--only to be branded a traitor and thrown off a cliff. Just before his death, he realizes two grave mistakes: He gained immense power through Gyuhwa Bojeon at the cost of losing his manhood. He failed to eliminate the vile traitors Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong when he had the chance. But instead of dying, Jinmyeong awakens in a mysterious realm, where he encounters the original copy of Gyuhwa Bojeon , and is sent 32 years back in time--right before he lost his manhood. Now, with his body intact and the power of Gyuhwa Bojeon still coursing through him, Jinmyeong embarks on a new path. This time, he will correct the regrets of his past life... and seek vengeance against Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong, the men who betrayed him.

title: The Fake Master Who Accidentally Became the Strongest
description: One day, I was involved in a traffic accident, and when I woke up, I had been reincarnated as a genius teacher at a magic academy named Chris. But whether it was a trick of the gods or fate, this person had a major flaw. In this world where every living being except monsters can use magic, she was an "illegal player"--someone completely unable to use magic. There was only one way to avoid being deemed a monster and executed: I had to fully play the role of a "lazy but secretly talented teacher" and keep fooling the gifted students around me. However, maybe I played the role too well... "I'll follow you forever, Sensei!" "I swear my loyalty to Chris Daughton!" Even though I'm just an ordinary reincarnated person with no magic, I somehow ended up with a bunch of overly enthusiastic disciples, and now things are even more complicated... Ah, maintaining a character persona is truly hard.

title: The Former Mercenary's Life As A Prosecutor
description: The ones who took away my entire life, they will pay for it." To uncover the secret behind his mother's death, legendary mercenary Lee Jeong-hwan returns as a prosecutor. His revenge begins against those who took his mother's life and trampled on his once-ordinary existence. Threats that stand in his way will be dealt with by force, and those who deserve judgment will be dealt by the law.

title: The Former Strongest Hero Lives as a Side Character
description: Blanc, the most powerful Grade-0 Adventurer, known across the world as the Black Emperor. After slaying the Black Dragon that plunged the world into despair, he became a legendary hero. And then, he made a shocking declaration: "I'm retiring from being a Grade-0 Adventurer." Now walking a new path, Blanc--once hailed as the strongest--takes on humble odd jobs as he begins a quiet journey of self-discovery. From Miku, the creator of "The Fruit of Evolution", comes a bold new fantasy brought to life on an epic scale!

title: The Fortune-Making Crafter: Unrivaled in Business with an Unfavored Class
description: In a world where people enter dungeons dreaming of getting rich overnight, Souma spends his days passionately crafting items despite having the unlucky job class of "Crafter." But one day, his younger sister suddenly turns into a monster. To restore her to normal, they somehow need 100 million gold. Hunt, craft, and sell. A thrilling dungeon battle story begins.

title: The Fox-Eyed Villain of the Demon Academy
description: The very last moment before the novel was about the end... The strongest villain met a pitiful fate. But that wasn't the end. "So, this is how I die." I, who was once the author, woke up as the fox-eyed villian who was never once understood. A fallen family. A life thrown away for revenge. A future sealed in tragedy. I'm going to rewrite it all. This villain's end... will be reversed.

title: The General - Fighting Legend
description: Kwon, known as the "martial god who guards Goryeo," wasn't always a legendary general. His story begins in childhood, alongside his older brother Jeong. The two are sons of Manjeok, once the strongest martial artist in Goryeo and a slave. When Manjeok launches a slave-liberation uprising and fails, he is executed, and Jeong and Kwon find their lives constantly under threat. While hiding to survive and training in their father's martial arts, the brothers are attacked by masters; Jeong is killed, and Kwon barely escapes with his life. Fleeing, he loses consciousness--and wakes up in a brutal Song-dynasty fighting arena, not a mere ring but an entire region where only the strong survive. There, Kwon resolves to grow stronger for the sake of revenge, vowing to become the mightiest of all and return to kill the one who took his brother's life. LATEST MANGA RELEASES

title: The Genius Assassin's Second Life Begins at the Academy
description: Van, feared as the strongest assassin in a world ruled by magicians, earned his title without ever wielding magic. Relying on unmatched combat skill and vast knowledge of sorcery, he fought in the shadows to secure the throne for his best friend--the prince. His true goal was to protect his own persecuted people, the only race born without magic. But at the end of the brutal succession war, Van's loyalty was betrayed. His closest friend murdered his family and left him for dead. When Van opened his eyes again, he found himself ten years in the past. Granted a second chance, he refuses to walk the same path. This time, his decision is clear: he will rise to the very top of the magic academy--without magic. Thus begins the tale of the world's greatest assassin, rewriting destiny from the shadows of the classroom.

title: The Glutton
description: The human world was destroyed by the demon lords. Having lost everything, the awakened warrior Si Chen chooses to launch a desperate, final attack sacrificing himself in order to take down the demon lord of gluttony, Lan Yue. But when he wakes up again, he finds himself transported ten years into the past, before any of this happened. Realizing that his powers have awakened earlier, he decides he must act early. With his return, everything else in the world seems to have changed as well

title: The God of Ad-Libs
description: Thirty-year-old unemployed Lee Tae-gyu. At some point, he began living a numb, lethargic life, entirely cut off from his own emotions. While struggling to escape his meaningless daily life, a fateful encounter with an enigmatic old man blesses him with the power of the phantom flame--the ability to 'copy' the feelings of those around him

title: The God's Contract in the Virtual World
description: In 2035, with AI technology at its peak, unemployment has soared to 40%. Out of this chaos, a virtual game for the elite was born--"GOLDGAME." In this deadly game, players gamble their lives, but the prize is unimaginable wealth and a chance to turn their fate around. Chen Mo, an unemployed AI researcher, dives into the game to find his missing sister. Time and again, he survives the brutal trials of this merciless game, transforming from a mere player into a god.

title: The Great Sword Hero The Scrap Loved by God
description: Read Manhwa / MangaToon The Great Sword Hero: The Scrap Loved by God / The Sword-Forging Great Hero: The Scrap Favored by the Kings / The Great Hero of the Genesis Sword ~Trash Beloved by King~ / The Great Sword Hero: The Scrap Loved by King / ?????????????????? In a world where "Hunters" conquer "Ruins" that appeared from another realm, seeking treasures within... Kurogane Touma, a dropout and failure, risks his life challenging an ultra-high difficulty dungeon to save his sister, who suffers from a terrible illness. What awaits him there is an encounter with the strongest sword--and "Aion," a supernatural entity that devours love. The battle to save his sister and the world begins!

title: The Guild's Strongest Receptionist
description: In the modern age where dungeons have appeared... In a world where everything is decided by a player's blessing, Iijima Joji surprisingly gets the lowest aptitude of a G-rank Blessing. He had a terrible start as a player, being forced into debt by his friends and ridiculed for his incompetence. However, by chance, he was forced to participate in an unending tutorial... XX years have passed. He reached level 9999, but the endlessly repeating tutorial was about to break him. -- and then his level increased. When he reached the other side of the countdown, the world was bugged, and he went back in time to the moment he woke up as a player, and he had to start his life over again at an extraordinary level. "Who is he? Why is such a monster working as a guild receptionist?" When he swings his arm, buildings disappear. When he casts magic, disasters occur.

title: The Heavenly Demon Cult's Strongest Maid
description: I was just an ordinary office worker... until I woke up as Shin Seol-ha, a lowly maid inside a martial arts novel. To support the grandmother who raised her, Seol-ha entered the dreaded Demonic Cult as a servant, surviving a grueling five-year contract. Finally, with just two months left until her freedom, her plans are completely shattered. Of all people, she is reassigned as the personal maid to Jeok Igeon, a man utterly infamous for his cruelty. While keeping her head down to survive, Seol-ha accidentally discovers a hidden, monstrous talent for martial arts, with Igeon's help. To make matters worse, she suddenly has the attention of the entire Demonic Cult, culminating in an offer to become the Heavenly Demon's personal disciple! Wait, why is everyone suddenly so obsessed with me?! Seol-ha just wants to escape the Cult, but Jeok Igeon refuses to let her go. Just where will this increasingly tangled relationship end?

title: The Hero Starts Over at the Academy
description: Misato Kyoichiro, the leader of the strongest group of adventurers, the "Golden Seekers," was betrayed by his comrades and left to die. "I won't just die like this!!" In his final moments, he activated a reincarnation spell. Kyoichiro successfully reincarnated twenty years later as a student named Asai Kyosuke, a wielder of the "Void" attribute. "Void" is an attribute mocked for being "attributeless," but Kyoichiro knew the truth of this attribute, thanks to the "Time" attribute he had in his previous life. The "Void" attribute has the potential to surpass the "Time" attribute, which was seen as the strongest in his lifetime. Thus, reborn as Asai Kyosuke, he returns to the Adventurer Academy, determined to purge all evil from society; all to get revenge on his former comrades, who betrayed him out of greed. And... "Asai Kyosuke, I won't let anyone look down on you ever again." ...to reach the peak of strength, something he could not achieve in his previous life.

title: The Hunter Lives In A rented Apartment
description: Ten years ago, on the day of the first Great Rift, Jiho lost his father, who was a brave firefighter. Ever since, he has dedicated himself to becoming a Hunter, training constantly for the Hunter Association Exam. One day, in the midst of his training, a sudden rift outbreak engulfs him--and Jiho's life turned upside down.

title: The Immortal Genius Spearman
description: "In this life, I'll be the one who rules the battlefield." Damian, a centurion in the Baroque Kingdom's punishment unit, dies nameless on some forgotten front at the age of thirty, regretting only one thing: "Damn it... If I'd just had one more chance, I really would've ruled the battlefield with these guys." When he opens his eyes again, he's gone back seventeen years--this time with a perfectly intact mana core that actually lets him learn magic. This time, he swears, he won't be swept along by an age of endless war. He'll climb higher than anyone and become the one who dominates it. Reborn in the past, Damian raises his spear toward the world and begins carving out the future he couldn't reach before.

title: The Last Master of Jongnam Sect
description: "You must be the one to reign over the world!" With those parting words, Jin Sanwol's fate was sealed. At just 23 years old, he becomes the head of the Jongnam Sect, once a proud and powerful clan, now reduced to only eight remaining disciples and barely clinging to survival. Once a sect that dreamed of dominating the martial world, it is now a shadow of its former glory. Yet Sanwol cannot afford to grieve or hesitate. To honor his master's dying wish, to keep the sect alive, and to carve a new path-- Jin Sanwol must step into the ruthless world of martial arts, where only the strongest survive. The battle for supremacy begins anew, and he must stake everything to reclaim his sect's former greatness... and conquer the martial world.

title: The Loner Loser Necromancer
description: NA

title: The Mad Dog of the Duke's Estate
description: I lived my whole life as a slave, bound by a leash. But there was one thing that I was able to choose for myself: the place where I would die. "...Any last words?" My only friend asked me in a calm voice, and I quietly replied as I closed my eyes. "Waaaah!" ...Waaaah? To cut to the chase, I was reincarnated. And not just as anyone, but as my friend's youngest grandson. So, what am I going to do now? Well, what else can I do? I'm going to cause chaos.

title: The Mercenary Group's Beloved Child: The Orphan on the Brink of Death is Raised by the Mightiest Masters
description: Young Will was an orphan with no one to rely on, left to waste away in the slums.On the brink of death, he was saved by a passing mercenary, changing his fate forever. Determined to survive, Will asks to join the legendary mercenary corps-a unit known as the strongest in the kingdom. The entry test was supposed to be impossible, but against all odds, his hidden talents shine through. Recognizing his potential, the mercenaries grant him a trial membership. Under the guidance of some of the world's most powerful warriors, Will hones his combat skills, strategy, and instincts at an unparalleled rate. Before long, even the most seasoned mercenaries begin to acknowledge his exceptional growth. A boy raised by monsters of war, forging his own unstoppable legend- A high-paced, ultimate growth fantasy begins!

title: The Monster's Undertaker
description: One day, a meteor falls on the once peaceful Earth, and across the globe, "immortals" begin to appear. These individuals experience a strange phenomenon: the moment they die, their entire bodies are "reset" to a specific point in time. Even wounds or scribbles made after that reset point vanish without a trace. Society plunges into chaos due to this incomprehensible scientific anomaly. 200 years later, scientists still haven't uncovered the secret of eternal life. Immortals live as fugitives or test subjects, wanted by governments. And to those who continue to live without the ability to die, a rumor begins to spread of a man known as the "Undertaker," who can truly kill immortals... by demonicscans.org

title: The Old Prisoner Lives in Solitude
description: "Solitude" the deadliest prison in the universe, Karaismán. Its structure changes daily, and thousands die within its walls every single day. Yet, there is one infamous inmate who has survived for 64 years: Argel Lastos. Though officially ranked as nothing more than a Class-1, Argel has always emerged victorious no matter who he fights, regardless of their level. He survives through strategy, combat prowess, loyal allies, and knowledge. To maintain his aging, frail body, Argel made a contract with Karaismán's creators the very ones who designed "Solitude." In return, they assign him a mission: to protect a "product" of great value. This time, that "product" is a blond-haired boy... Thus begins an intense and overwhelming tale, a dark sci-fi fantasy action story starring the universe's strongest old man.

title: The Ordinary Lawyer's Subspace
description: A strange door appeared in front of lawyer Han Beomsang. Beyond it lies a space where time does not flow

title: The Player of a Fallen Prestigious Family
description: Riyun, the youngest son of the prestigious Sermin Family, faced tragedy after his father and brothers disappeared. Captured by the Phaton Family, he met a grim end through unimaginable torture. However, he awoke in Adeon, a treacherous battlefield where he became the powerful Ghost King, mastering various classes. Though defeated, he returned to his twelve-year-old self, still possessing a player's experience. Determined to stop his family's downfall and reclaim what was lost, Riyun seeks bloody revenge against the Phaton Family, the very house that brought down the Sermins and murdered him.

title: The Prosecutor Kim Seo jin
description: Read Manhwa Prosecutor Kim Seo-jin / Prosecutor Kim Seo Jin / ?? ??? Veteran prosecutor Seo Jun-gyeong made a career out of digging into the corruption of the entrenched elite. One day, he is falsely framed as a sexual assault suspect and murdered in what is staged to look like a suicide. ...He thought he was dead--until he wakes up in someone else's body: that of Kim Seo-jin, an intern prosecutor who also happens to be the nephew of his archenemy. After this second life begins, he gains a special ability: psychometry, the power to read past memories from people and objects through touch. Using this ability, he starts crushing, one by one, the corrupt figures in politics and business, along with the enemies who drove him to his death. "In this life, I'm throwing away shallow words like justice, law, and humanity. I'll take everything--money, power, all of it." It is a revenge-driven legal thriller about a once-idealistic prosecutor reincarnated into his enemy's family, now using supernatural powers and insider status to dismantle the rotten system from within while abandoning his former belief in pure justice.

title: The Rebel of the Tyrant Noble House
description: Ash devoted his life to serving his adoptive father, repaying the kindness of being taken in as an orphan. But at the moment of his death, he learned a devastating truth. Everything he had built--his efforts, his trust, even the ultimate power he was meant to possess, "The Seven Wings"--had all been stolen from him. ...Very well then. This time, I will take back what was mine.

title: The Regressed Extra Becomes a Genius
description: The story delves into the life of Kim Seon-woo, who got pulled into a famous novel and decided to live a quiet life as a side character. One day, the protagonist of said novel died... "...Do you expect me to believe this?" He ends up regressing back in time - back to his first day within the novel.

title: The Regressed Sword Saint's Magic Theory
description: In a world where humanity battles monsters, every warrior faces a critical choice between two paths: become a mage who wields supernatural miracles, or become a swordsman who masters superhuman techniques. Oscar chose the path of the sword. From childhood, he swung his blade relentlessly, eventually climbing to the pinnacle as a ?? (Sword Saint)--the highest rank a swordsman can achieve. He cut down ferocious monsters, received the admiration of the people, and walked a path that anyone would envy. Yet deep in his heart, Oscar harbored a secret longing--he had always wanted to become a mage instead.

title: The Regressor Makes Everything
description: Lee Se-Hoon, the blacksmith of humanity's last desperate united force, fought against the demons until the very end. However, the result was mutual destruction, with the world coming to an end. The moment he took his own life over that futile conclusion-- "...What is this?" He had regressed to his days as a candidate at the hero training institution, Babel Academy. Having obtained a second chance, he swore to use anything as material to gain victory this time. Anything at all!

title: The Reincarnated Demon King Dominates the Modern World
description: Danterio, the "kind Demon King" who once saved the world from an angelic invasion, fights a final battle and then loses consciousness. When he next opens his eyes, he finds himself 600 years in the future--in modern Japan--reborn in the body of a young man named Daiya Mizukami, who died from bullying and an overdose of magic-enhancing drugs. Learning of Daiya's bitter regrets, the Demon King first deals with the problem right in front of him: he crushes the bullies who drove Daiya to his death in an instant. But when he looks at the wider world, he discovers that magic has weakened, and the angels he once defeated have begun to move again. "I am the Demon King, Danterio. I will teach you... how to kill angels." Thus begins a modern battle-action story where the strongest Demon King rampages through contemporary Japan, combining reincarnation, school life, and brutal angel-slaying action.

title: The Reincarnation of God-Level Crafting
description: In an alternate world where a super popular game has become reality, the profession Allen chose was the "dud job," Crafter. However, when the memories of his previous life and game knowledge are combined, Crafter transforms into the strongest cheat job! Bringing modern weaponry into a fantasy world and dominating, the strongest protagonist--possessing power enough to influence the fate of the world--aims to reach the level cap at the fastest speed in history!

title: The Remarkable Revenge of a Vindictive Villainess (Official)
description: The protagonist awakens to find herself reincarnated as Lunaria il von Solfege, her beloved villainess from her favorite game. However, along with this new identity come Lunaria's tragic memories--public condemnation, complete abandonment, and ultimately, a desperate attempt to take her own life with a dagger. "You can leave everything to me, Lunaria. Now that I am you, I will never let them get away with this," she vows. The remarkable revenge of a villainess fighting for the sake of love starts here.

title: The Reset Life of a Game Addict
description: Jinho Lee has just completed the ultimate challenge in the game Reset Life, where he had to experience all 99 possible endings to reach the final victory. After six years of intense gameplay, he feels a sense of achievement--but also an overwhelming emptiness. With nothing left to conquer in the game, Jinho finds himself at a loss, unsure of what to do next. However, this feeling of burnout becomes the catalyst for an even greater transformation. Suddenly, Jinho's life is reset in ways he never imagined--he becomes the top scorer in the nation, a model, a chef, and even a celebrity. What once seemed like distant dreams are now his new reality. But with this newfound success comes the question: is this truly the life he wanted?

title: The Return of Namgung's Granddaughter
description: The anecdote of the small cult leader of the blood demon is that according to the will of his teacher, the blood demon, he exterminated the Nangong family. Due to the betrayal of the blood demon, he hears a shocking story before his death. "Now you are the only male palace left in the world." The anecdote is that he was a child he lost a long time ago in the Namgung family. He learns that he was raised for the manipulation of evil blood demons. The anecdote of returning from a grieving death to the days of being thirteen years old, or rather, the story of Namgung, realizes that the opportunity to change the future has come. He takes steps to prevent the destruction of the southern palace. Will Seol-hwa be able to prevent the family's destruction from the blood demon and succeed in revenge?

title: The Return of the Unrivaled Genius Ranker
description: A virtual reality game that swallowed the world--God of Savior. And the game that laid its foundation--Deus Ex Machina: Ragnarok, commonly known as Demrock. At its peak stood Kaiser, the undisputed ranker who held the absolute #1 spot. Once revered as a god, he vanished due to unavoidable circumstances... Now, after 1 year and 6 months, he has returned. "Would you like to log in?"

title: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!
description: A C-rank tank, abandoned by her teammates to die, awakens a rare regenerative ability after enduring countless deaths. Now immortal but traumatized, she must decide her next move in a world that betrayed her.

title: The Returnee's Hidden Strategy Stream
description: "I came back to overcome my 55th regression." Hanbit, the protagonist, is abducted by a goddess and thrown into the world of Erfort, where he must search for a way to save it. To find that solution, he goes through 55 full cycles of regression--meaning he also endures the pain of dying 55 times. When he finally breaks down and tells the goddess he can't take it anymore, he's sent back to his original world. Then, just for fun, he starts playing a new game... only to realize it's the very same world where he went through those 55 regressions. The deeper he digs into the game, the clearer it becomes that a dark conspiracy of the goddess is lurking behind everything. Can Hanbit expose the goddess's true, sinister intentions?

title: The Revenge of the Betrayed Strongest Knight
description: Klein, who fell from the throne of the King of Knights, was betrayed by his comrades and sentenced to be burned at the stake. In his final moments, Klein scoffs at the foolishness of this world and his past self. Now, having returned from hell, Klein has gained unparalleled power. He will make those who betrayed him pay the price...

title: The Rise of the Bottom Ranked spirit user
description: In the year 20XX, the existence of spirits became known to humanity, and those who wielded their power came to be called "Spirit Users." While mankind used this power to advance society, it was also not uncommon for people to use their powers for evil. Amidst this backdrop, Yui Shinonome, an overworked office worker fired from an exploitative company, obtains the power of a spirit through a strange twist of fate. With no time to grasp his new reality, Yui is dragged into the conflicts of Spirit Users and becomes a member of the Bureau of Fairy Affairs, commonly known as the BFA. Thus began his days of solving spirit-related incidents. Although Yui believed he was hired merely as a general affairs clerk, he is partnered with the BFA's number one problem child: Mio Shinohara. Despite her immense skill, her reckless, order-defying attitude has caused all of her previous partners to quit, unable to endure working with her. While the two repeatedly clash, they gradually begin to form a deep bond. Soon, Yui learns of Mio's tragic past--her parents were murdered by someone who misused spirit powers, leaving her with a strong desire for revenge. Furthermore, it is revealed that the spirit lending Yui its power is no ordinary spirit, but the former Spirit King who was once betrayed and lost his life. Yui makes a firm vow: to race up the ladder of success and win the heart of his beloved.

title: The Saint Who Levels Up as a Necromancer
description: They called him the "Creepy Necromancer"... Feared. Hated. Completely alone. Yet Ryuga Chinen rose to the peak--reaching the legendary 9-Star rank without any god's blessing. That was his mistake. The gods feared him. So they betrayed him. Framed by the very beings who ruled the world... he was executed. But death wasn't the end. Guided by a mysterious holy relic, Ryuga regresses--returning to the past with all his memories intact. This time, everything will be different. Now, he wields not only his past knowledge... but also a Constellation's power. And his goal? To crush the arrogant gods who once killed him. As the only existence with both forbidden knowledge and divine protection... his rise begins again--faster, deadlier, unstoppable.

title: The Savior Zero: Saving the World with a Unique Skill from Zero Magic
description: In a world where magic is commonplace, Ikuta Kouki was scorned due to his peculiar constitution: Zero Magic Power . Amidst this, a Great Sorcerer predicted the arrival of the "End of the World" and the existence of seven Saviors to rescue humanity. These "Saviors" became worshipped, gained authority, and began to rule over the people. However, five years later, when the End of the World actually arrived, the promised Saviors proved to be completely powerless . In a moment of despair, Kouki's dying older sister sees a glimpse of latent power within him. She uses her last ounce of strength to cast the forbidden spell, "Regression." After telling him, "I want you to save the world," Kouki awakens to find himself back in the world of five years ago, where people still believe in the "False Saviors." Now, Kouki rises up, using his newly awakened skill, "Creation," to become the true Savior, rescue the people who have been misled, and save the world from its predetermined doom.

title: The Secret Martial Artist of Demonic Blood
description: A martial arts researcher who lived an unfortunate life plagued by illness finally meets his end. At the moment of death, a mysterious power transports him to "Gaia"--a world where magic and martial arts coexist. He is reborn as Louis, an abandoned child bearing black hair and black eyes, traits considered symbols of misfortune and ill omen in this new world. Despite this stigma, he is determined to fulfill the dreams he could never achieve in his previous life.

title: The Shepherd Wizard
description: There stood a seemingly ordinary shepherd named Turan from Hisaril Hill. Having lived while hiding his talent as a great archwizard, he finally steps out into the world.

title: The Silent Transfer Student
description: The transfer student who never speaks brings the class bully to submission one day with an overwhelming difference in skill. Because of this fight, he draws the attention of bullies from every school. Meanwhile, another female student silently watches him.

title: The Smiling Boxer
description: Gang Chan, a young man from a rural village, dreams of becoming a boxing champion. To repay the elders who raised him, he trains relentlessly every single day. But one day, a group of men in black storm into the village, intent on pushing a shady redevelopment project. Gang Chan stands up to protect the villagers, but the odds are overwhelming. As he breaks down in tears, blaming himself for failing them, someone appears... someone who will change his fate forever.

title: The Sorcerer Manual
description: In 1668, our city earned the title of "The Safest Place in the Country." I had a lot to do with that. How? Because I was arrested. TL Extra: This is adapted from a well-rated Chinese webnovel called "Sorcerer's Handbook". According to reviews, it stands out among other System/Transmigration novels and has even been compared to Lord of the Mysteries for its similarities. It's also said to have strong worldbuilding and character development, assuming the adaptation does it justice.

title: The Steel Emperor
description: Heroes of Gauri, Conquer Another World! The most glorious name in this land, Gauri.The one who protected that name. People call him the Steel Emperor!The last Great General of the fallen Gauri (Goguryeo), "Go Jincheon." At the moment of their fall, he and his elite unit, the 'Black-Armored Demon Cavalry', fall into another world.A strange land where various races such as Elves, Orcs, Dwarves, and Wizards live.If they cannot return There is no choice but to establish a new Gauri. Go Jincheon raises his banner once more for the conquest of the continent.

title: The Strongest Crystal Beast Master
description: Young Chen Xing formed a bond with Lily, the "Fated Queen" of the Crystal Beast Realm, becoming the first awakener to contract with a humanoid crystal beast. He gained a special ability to turn crystal beasts into beautiful girls and set out on a journey of battle and power to become the "Strongest Crystal Beast Master." Jealous? I've got countless humanoid crystal beast girls like her!

title: The Strongest Hero with Negative Destructive Power
description: Decades have passed since the world became flooded with monsters. The protagonist, who enrolled in an academy to train those with aptitude, consistently ranked last in ability tests. It would have been one thing if his abilities were merely low, but because he also inflicted a debuff (ability reduction) on his surrounding comrades, he was called "unwanted" and a "burden." One day, while exploring, the protagonist is swallowed by a different dimension and goes missing. There, he encounters a creature from another world and is told the true value of his ability. Originally, magical power is something used to attack by projecting one's own power outwards. However, the protagonist's characteristic is the complete opposite of this "output"; it is "input" (absorption), and the ability to suck in external power is his true strength... "Reverse Magic Circuit." The reason he had been debuffing his allies until now was that he had been unknowingly absorbing their power. Having learned the true worth of his power, the protagonist now absorbs monster attacks to nullify them and gathers external power to strengthen himself, mastering his abilities and proceeding on the path to becoming the strongest.

title: The Strongest Level 0 Absolute Supremacy Through Analysis Skills
description: Mysterious "Disaster Beasts" suddenly appear on Earth and plunge humanity into an unprecedented crisis. Tenma Itsuki, whose parents were killed by these monsters, is chosen as an "Awakened," a human granted special abilities. The job he awakens to is a supposedly impossible rare job that overturns common sense: although his level is stuck at "Level 0," he possesses a cheat-like power that can analyze enemy skills and endlessly boost his own stats. Driven by vengeance, Tenma sets his sights on becoming the strongest human alive, and a max-hype superpower battle story begins as he uses his analysis skill to achieve absolute domination.

title: The Strongest Monster Killer Dad in History
description: Mitsuru Akai just moved from the countryside to the city with her father, Fuma--a man who once made a name for himself as a legendary Monster Killer. On her very first day at the new school, she's targeted by the local bully and dragged to a warehouse to be taught a lesson. But the bullying turns into a bloodbath when a swarm of monsters suddenly appears. Even stranger? It seems Mitsuru is the only one who can see them. Before she can make sense of it, she's abducted by two shady men posing as police officers. Now, a father's rage has been ignited. Fuma vows to get his daughter back at any cost, and the world's strongest father is about to show the city's worst monsters exactly why they should be afraid.

title: The Support Ate it All
description: The "S-rank Hero Factory" that raised 1,000 S-rank heroes. The graduates' manufacturing machine. The strongest support. These are all words that refer to me. But could this actually be the world of that game?

title: The Sword Emperor Who Surpasses His Previous Life
description: The House of Cardenas, the legendary sword that shields the Arcadia Empire, is feared as a powerhouse of absolute martial might. It is whispered that their direct descendants carry the blood of dragons, manifesting in supernatural powers known as "Unique Traits." Leonard Cardenas, a humble trainee in the family's academy, suddenly awakens the memories of his past life as Yeon Muhyuk, the man once hailed as the world's greatest Sword Emperor. Armed with the wisdom of a legend, Leonard begins his climb to the top, challenging the elite high-bloods and uncovering the dark secrets of the dragon's lineage. The journey to become the ultimate Sword Emperor begins now!

title: The Sword God From the Destroyed World
description: The world was destroyed. A land consumed by death and despair. And in the midst of it all, one man fought to the bitter end--the Sword God, Karselian Le Vandayan. But then, as if guided by fate, a door to another world opened. This time... it was Earth--a world that hadn't yet collapsed. There, monsters have begun to quietly emerge, while humanity lives on, blissfully unaware of the impending catastrophe. This world hasn't ended... But the moment they let their guard down, the nightmare will begin anew. To stop it, the Sword God raises his blade once more. He begins a new life, borrowing the body of a once-weak human. And in exchange for taking over that body, he makes a single promise: "I'll protect your family." And now, the real battle begins.

title: The Swordmaster Who Leapt Through Time
description: Due to the invasion of the empire, the kingdom is on the verge of collapse. The last prince of the kingdom, Lancel, leaves for a foreign land together with the children of the nobles. Struggling to survive, he puts in every effort, and at a young age, he becomes a swordma...

title: The Tale Of The Skeleton Messenger
description: 120 years after the Emperor's death, Benrira awakens. Once a member of the hero's party and Messenger of the Emperor. After losing his beloved disciple to his own corrupt motherland, he vows to deliver the Emperor's final message. [I am the Emperor's Messenger. Hear the will of the First Emperor.]

title: The Tang Clan Chronicles
description: Tang Mujin, a young physician hailing from the Tang Family Clinic of Sichuan, had a strange dream... ...one where he became the legendary blacksmith Ou Yezi and ascended to the heavens.

title: The Third Prince of the Fallen Kingdom has Regressed
description: From the stuido that brought you Moon-Shadow Sword Emperor and The Legendary Hero is an Academy Honors Student.] Yuri, the unruly third prince of the fallen Briol Kingdom. After meeting his end while wandering in guilt, he ended up regressing to the spring of his 13th year, before the Empire's invasion began! "Briols do not abandon honor, even in death." One harrowing regret is enough. The kingdom shall be saved from ruin!

title: The Thousand Faces Actor
description: "What do you think people will end up calling him?" Someone asked. But no one had an answer. A transcendent being has appeared in the world. And a new chapter in film history begins.

title: The Top Healer of the Offensive Magic Academy
description: Will was once the world's greatest healer, but he could not use offensive magic and always had to rely on his comrades in battle. Even though he healed their wounds, their spirits eventually broke, humanity lost its way to fight, and the human side was defeated by the Demon King's army. Just as Will is prepared to die, he regresses to just before the entrance ceremony of a magic academy. "This time, I'll fight with my own hands." With that vow, he chooses not the healing academy he once attended, but the prestigious offensive-magic school, Schwarz Academy. Although he still cannot use normal attack magic, he discovers a way to convert healing magic into offensive techniques and gradually distinguishes himself as a prodigy. Thus begins a healer's overpowered comeback story, starting from regression and turning the tables at an offensive magic academy.

title: The Trainer Lives Surrounded by Monsters: Abandoned by the Hero Party, He Became the Strongest after Meeting with a Legendary Monster
description: Ryu was left behind by his childhood friend's heroic party, who told him that they could not take a trainer with them. He runs a ranch in the village, but spends his days feeling unworthy. One day, he saves a wolf from a trap in the forest... The wolf he rescued was actually Fenrir, a legendary demon! The elder of the pack has lost his magical powers and was looking for someone to help him. No ordinary trainer can heal him, but Ryu has magical powers that exceed even those of the hero's childhood friend...? After successfully saving the elder, Ryu learns how to handle the enormous amount of magical power that could destroy him. He is adored by Fenrir's flock and becomes an extraordinary trainer!

title: The Turn-Bound Mage
description: "You criminal bastard... Can't you get your head straight?!" All I did was start the final difficulty level of the game "Abyss of the Labyrinth", and I ended up becoming a character in the game -- an "Otherworld Possessor." But worse, the character I became is a criminal turned slave?! However, every time I face a crisis, a magical ability called "Turn-Bound Hourglass" activates, freezing time for 60 seconds... I don't know if it was the developer or some god that threw me into this mess, But as a turn-Bounded mage, I will survive -- no matter what.

title: The Ultimate Tank
description: Shoya Ohno, a tank affiliated with the Japan Hunter Administration Bureau, is a man shrouded in mystery. He was drawn to the straightforward personality of Eda, the director of the Bureau, and despite receiving an extraordinary offer from the United States, he turned it down to continue operating in Japan for his own personal reasons. In truth, Shoya is a survivor who, ten years ago, was abducted to the otherworldly continent of Azelan. Despite enduring unimaginable suffering, he managed to return to Earth alive. To protect the Earth and to rescue his friends who were abducted just like he was-- Shoya continues to fight. And once that goal is fulfilled... He will rise to confront the continent of Azelan, which seeks to annihilate humanity on Earth through its gate invasions. Thus, Shoya sets his plan into motion.

title: The Vampire's Alchemy
