description: A strange encounter between a vampire and an alchemist. One seeks to rebuild a fallen noble house. The other is desperate to save a lost sibling. Together, they embark on a slightly uncomfortable (and undeniably bizarre) journey of blood, magic, and uneasy partnership. What could possibly go wrong when fangs meet formulas?

title: The Veteran Swordmaster's Stream
description: NA

title: The Villain's Profiler
description: Through psychological analysis and profiling, he gets rid of evil humans. Lee Sinhyeok lost his mother to a murderer and had an accident. After stacking up knowledge in a mysterious space where he could learn and study for 15 years, he wakes up from a coma. This is the story of a genius who uses his 15 years of knowlege and skills to unravel the injustices of the dead, and of those who are a dangerous threat to people in becoming a profiler; the pinnacle of a profliler.

title: The Weakest Slime I Once Saved Became the Strongest and Now Won't Leave My Side
description: "I never want to lose someone important to me again." One day, I, a nerdy and bullied boy, was provoked by my classmates to go to an SS-ranked dungeon. Facing an SS-class black dragon that I couldn't do anything about, my chances of survival were zero... At that moment, someone appeared before my eyes... This is the story of the bond between the strongest slime and the weakest me, as we grow together.

title: The World-Class Extra's Walkthrough
description: [God Dog]: I'm looking for someone to attempt life for a second time. At the joke-like chatting, I ended up responding with a joke. [JjamBbong Taste Clementine]: Second time, let's go go go go. [God Dog]: Are you confident? It's not going to be easy, you know? [JjamBbong Taste Clementine]: Don't I just have to do the same thing over again in this shitty game? Hehehehe. But the result of this... "The third prince of the Magic Kingdom, Guillaume!" "......Who?" I became the third prince inside of that game. An eerily shining cold steel blade touched my neck. This, though unbelievable, had become my reality. "Now, third prince. Any last words?" "......What is this b*tchy situation?" "Haha, b*tchy? Those definitely sound like the words of a wastrel. Goodbye. Third Prince." The miserable end of an extra NPC. Just as the blade was about to fall on my neck...! [Gameplay has started.] [Player 'Kim Kyung Sam' will lay as the 'Wastrel Third Prince'!] The game I grinded my life into had become my reality. But... 'I will not die.' 'And I will not be defeated.' Because I know this game from the beginning to the end.

title: The Youngest Son of the Eunhae Merchant Group
description: The youngest son of the Eunhae Merchant Group, Eun Seoho, was born with a talent for business. "How could the Murim Alliance do this to me...?" "The higher-ups of the Alliance find you a nuisance. Tch, all this just for money." He was murdered by the Murim Alliance and regressed back to the days when he was learning the workings of the Eunhae Merchant Group. Seoho is determined to live this second life without regrets. "I'll take you all down with the very thing you scoffed at--money." Thus begins the journey of the great business emperor, Eun Seoho, whose genius brain and martial talent will go down in history!

title: The Zombie Won't Bite Me
description: When Yihwan woke up, the world had changed. Zombies roamed the streets, thirsting for human blood, while the living fought desperately to survive. But... "Why aren't the zombies biting me?" With an unnatural strength surging through his body, one eye glowing red like the undead, and a strange hunger rising at the sight of blood... "What... happened to me?

title: To Hell with Being Heir, I'm going to Heal
description: After defeating the evil that threatened the world, peace was finally restored to the world of . I have possessed a game that was failing, with nothing but an oxygen mask to keep it alive! "I Don't Care About Being the Heir, I Just Want to Heal" Lion Asteri, the eldest grandson of a magic noble family that even the emperor looks down upon. One day, when he went out despite his frail body...... Pop! [You have acquired Aqua Rosemary!] 'Gathering herbs just by pulling them out? This place is heaven!' A world where fair compensation follows your efforts! With a background that leaves nothing to be desired, they want me to live as the heir of the family? "My younger brother should be the family head. Absolutely!" Heartwarming brotherhood and familial love! Armed with limitless vitality, Lion's sweet healing life begins! **Original Novel:** [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65909500)

title: To Hell With the Status Window
description: The strongest man of the Murim, "Asura," got transported to another world. Having reached the pinnacle through his martial capabilities alone, he smashes the status window and the tower with his own hands--rejecting participation as a player outright.

title: Trapped in a Crazy World as an Extra
description: "To think I'd be thrown into this trash heap of a world!" The Chronicles of the Seven-Colored World -- a series that ran for over 800 episodes and earned its fair share of curses from readers. A batshit crazy world full of absurd plot twists, endlessly evolving monsters, and heroines who try to kill the protagonist at every turn. "And I got reincarnated into this mess?" I've ended up as a nobody named Rudian -- a total background character. But with a freaky eyeball monster I happened to pick up, Adi, and a demonic sword called Diablo by my side,

title: Trillions of Resources in Apocalypse
description: Constantly slapping faces is constantly satisfying. Holding trillions in resources, slapping the faces of terrible women, conquering goddesses, Chen Yu is bound to the Scumbag System, sweeping away all powerful enemies in the apocalypse, and subduing countless otaku goddesses!

title: Tyrant of the Otherworld Prison: My Shadow Can Evolve Infinitely
description: In the year 2035, rifts to alien realms tore through the world's defenses. Swarms of insectoids and beastkin ravaged the land, and humanity struggled to survive through the strength of "Evolvers." Li Yi was betrayed by his teammates during an attack by alien beings and left for dead. On the brink of death, he awakened the "Titan Shadow" System--his shadow could evolve without limits! It could devour ores to enhance defense, tear through enemies to form deadly blades, and even split into an army of shadow soldiers... From insect hives to haunted lands, wherever his shadow passed, enemies were shredded into pulp. This is the revenge of the weak--begun with a shadow that devours all.

title: Ultimate Trump Card
description: "Snow weighs heavy on the branches, yet they do not cling to the mud. When the red sun rises, they once again touch the sky." Poker monsters have secretly invaded reality, bringing both catastrophe and a mysterious gift -- Mirror Poker, a supernatural game that grants its users longevity and special abilities. Chen Qi, whose life was once happy, is suddenly diagnosed with a terminal illness and given only one year to live. As he struggles in the depths of despair, he unexpectedly obtains a Mirror Poker card. In order to extend his life, Chen Qi dives deeper into the secrets behind Mirror Poker...

title: Unemployed Gye Baeksun
description: With no savings, average qualifications, and a bank balance consistently below 10,000 won, can the Backbone Breaker Gye Baeksun really escape unemployment?

title: Unrivaled Spear Demon
description: Shuji, a soldier who danced with death many times while on the battlefield, was possessed by the grudges and resentment of those he had killed. He too was eventually killed, but somehow he awoke in a younger version of himself. He returned to a time when he was still an errand boy, inexperienced with war, but retained his memories. Remembering Kyo Aiyo, his comrade and savior, Shuji travelled to the 'Tiger Pit' Sect. However, instead of the strong and reliable woman, he was met with a cheerful and petite girl. He recalled the tragic past that had caused her to devote herself to the army, where in his previous life her family had fallen apart due to false rumors. 'This time, I will protect you.' He vowed to repay the kindness he received in his previous life by changing her fate. With a spear in his right hand, Shuji steps into the battlefield once again, becoming the Unrivaled Spear Demon.

title: Urban Dragon Revealed
description: Wang Han, who stirred up international turmoil, lived in seclusion in the city and started delivering takeouts. After a drunken binge, he got the daughter of the Su family pregnant, and his peaceful life was disrupted again. When the torrent was surging, the hidden dragon was born, shaking the world!

title: Veteran of the Apocalypse
description: He was just an ordinary man running a small restaurant. But behind that quiet life hid his true identity... A legendary hardcore veteran who spent thousands of hours mastering a zombie-survival VR game. Then one day, the world changed. The virtual battleground he had died and revived in countless times suddenly became reality. A sudden zombie apocalypse erupts. At the same moment, he awakens a mysterious ability to open dimensional gates-- allowing him to travel freely between Earth and another world to prepare for the coming end. Soon, familiar figures from his gaming past begin to "log in" to reality: the infinitely respawning Rabbit Princess, the monster-controlling DuckButt-QuackQuack, and other absurdly overpowered comrades from the old days. Civilization collapses. The line between humanity and survival instinct grows faint. But he stands firm. "This isn't a game. But for me... it's a battlefield I know better than anyone." As the strongest former players gather at the end of the world, one final choice awaits them all--

title: Vicious Dog
description: In Country H, the Juvenile Law was revised to set the maximum penalty at life imprisonment. In exchange, underage offenders are sent to a rehabilitation facility known as the "Juvenile Reformatory." However, this purely nominal punishment has backfired, leading to a surge in juvenile crime and bullying. Gen Amamori, a high school student living in Country H, suffers through brutal bullying every single day. One day, his beloved dog is mauled to death by a dog belonging to his bully, Kanemoto. Pushed past his breaking point, Gen snaps and inflicts a severe injury on Kanemoto, resulting in his incarceration at the Reformatory. Even within the facility, Gen finds himself at the absolute bottom of the hierarchy, subjected to constant violence. However, a chance encounter leads him to become the protégé of Seiya Kojo, the strongest man in the Reformatory. In a hellish environment where violence is the only law, can Gen survive? This is the story of a man crawling his way up from the very bottom.

title: Voodoo Slam
description: On the night of a brutal slave hunt, a young girl named Faya loses her mother to the horrors of violence and betrayal. Left with nothing but her grief and rage, she embraces the forbidden path of voodoo sorcery. From blood-soaked rituals to bone-chilling spells, Faya transforms into a terrifying Voodoo Priestess, wielding dark powers to bring her enemies to their knees. Every chant, every curse, and every slam of her ritual staff drives her closer to vengeance. But with each victory, the boundary between justice and monstrosity begins to blur. Is Faya still human... or has she become something far darker than those she seeks to destroy? A haunting tale of revenge, magic, and survival begins--welcome to the world of Voodoo Slam.

title: Warrior of the Sword Heart
description: People call those who can draw the Sword of the Heart, 'Heroes'. Ellen sets off on a journey to become a Hero, but he soon learns the champions he dreamed of being are nothing more than brutal weapons of war. Will Ellen manage to overcome this reality and become a true Hero?

title: Water Magician
description: This is the story of Ryo, who was reincarnated in the world of swords and magic.It is a story of the royal road to survive using the magic of water attribute.What is magic? What is swordsmanship?How does it relate to the laws of physics that we know?Or what is politics? What is a nation?Why are there many ?kingdoms? in reincarnation stories? Will republics not work?Can it be written ...?Since it is a water-based magician, so it shall start with ?Hydrogen bond?!

title: When a Genius Office Worker Goes Too Far
description: A genius marketer from Korea's top film company, the only employee ever to fail peer evaluations, and the company's public enemy number one for being caught up in a bribery scandal. These labels sum up Han-rok's life as a corporate employee. All he ever wanted was to focus on his work. But his refusal to play politics or suck up to anyone--his decision to avoid aligning with any "faction"-- Came back to bite him in the form of betrayal and false accusations. Just when he hit rock bottom, He found himself back on that day, five years ago, when everything began to unravel. Determined never to be a victim again, Han-rok starts to cross the line. And for the first time, He begins to see the threads of the real problem that had always been hidden.

title: Wild Ranker
description: Everything in this world is ranked. In the quiet village of Tori lives a boy named Lowe. One day, his peaceful life is shattered when the village is destroyed by a mysterious force known only as the Island of the gods. Why was the village targeted? What secrets lie behind its destruction? Determined to uncover the truth, Lowe vows to set foot on the Island of the gods himself. But there's a catch--only adventurers ranked in the top 10 are allowed to enter the island. To achieve this, Low begins intensive training under Adol, the number one ranked knight. Thus begins his journey to climb the ranks, uncover the mystery, and face the gods themselves. "I'll become the number one ranker--no matter what it takes. And I will uncover the truth!"

title: Worker Rebrith: Master of Martial Arts
description: Introduction: Huo Guo, a miserable worker, died suddenly while working overtime, but was reborn in a different world that advocates force, and awakened the "Martial Arts Master Training System". He didn't expect that the other world was also a black-hearted devil's den that exploited workers. The gentle and sultry girl with glasses, the domineering female boss, and the seductive secretary are all my colleagues! This time, not only do I have to lead the girls to play in the workplace, but I also have to dominate the other world with force and reach the peak of my life!

title: World's Strongest Survivor
description: "It isn't the strongest who survives. The one who survives is the strongest." After being discharged from the military, Jin Seowoon did nothing but play games like a loser. One day, he was invited to the world of "Cloyd Survival," which resembled a game he enjoyed. In that world were masters of martial arts, kings from other worlds, and notorious killers... It was a gathering of monsters that surpassed human imagination. Jin Seowoon had just one objective--to survive and become one of the top ten. Here lies a tale of survival with Jin Seowoon's life at stake.

title: World-Saving is a Skill
description: I saved another world... only to find Earth in an even bigger mess. However, there's no need to worry. A guy who saved the world once can do it again.

title: Yongsa Kariel
description: The Demon King is dead, leaving only warriors in the world. Someone must fill that void

title: Zombie Herd
description: I'm Koo Seonghwan, former Jiu-Jitsu world champion. When I opened my eyes, the world had already fallen into ruin. Even if my body is infected... I must find my daughter...!
